You'll lead technical evaluations, deliver compelling demos, and guide customers through the journey from discovery to successful adoption. 

You'll act as a trusted advisor, bridging business goals with technical solutions, and play a key role in winning new business and expanding existing accounts.

At Datadog, we place value in our office culture - the relationships and collaboration it builds and the creativity it brings to the table. We operate as a hybrid workplace to ensure our Datadogs can create a work-life harmony that best fits them.

What You’ll Do:

  • Own the sales process in partnership with Account Executives by leading and shaping the technical strategy across opportunities from PG to Closed Won
  • Lead customer discovery to uncover technical challenges, business goals, and success criteria, then translate those needs into tailored Datadog solutions
  • Deliver engaging product demos, technical presentations, and workshops that connect platform capabilities to customer outcomes
  • Project manage technical evaluations (POVs) end-to-end: scoping use cases and requirements, defining success criteria, building a project plan with clear timelines, and holding all participants accountable to the process
  • Identify and cultivate technical champions within customer accounts, empowering them to advocate for Datadog adoption and drive consensus internally
  • Participat e actively in structured product and engineering field feedback sessions, serving as the technical voice of the customer to help shape product direction
  • Maintain operational excellence by ensuring activity, deal progress, and customer interactions are accurately documented and up to date in related systems 
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with Product, Support, and GTM teams to address customer needs and resolve technical blockers

Who You Are: 

  • 5+ years of experience in Sales Engineering, Solutions Engineering, or a technical customer-facing role within an enterprise environment
  • Skilled at navigating multi-stakeholder environments and adapting communication style to technical, business, and executive audiences
  • Proficient background in public cloud (AWS, Azure, GCP), Kubernetes, APM/tracing, security, developer experience, observability
  • Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts to a range of audiences
  • A consultative approach to problem-solving and customer engagement
  • Ability to manage multiple opportunities and priorities in a fast-paced environment
  • Growth mindset by embracing change and AI tools
  • Willingness to travel as needed to support customer engagements

description:

description:
We are Datadog's in-house product experts. The Technical Solutions (TS) team enables Datadog's worldwide growth by educating potential clients and ensuring that existing customers are happy and successful. Field CTOs are part of the broader Product Solutions Architecture (PSA) organization, serving as technical multipliers and trusted advisors to our customers' most senior decision makers and key executive stakeholders. They align customer ambitions with Datadog’s technology roadmap, enabling digital transformation while driving sustained growth for both our customers and Datadog.

As Datadog continues to scale, we are creating a Field CTO role to lead our GTM technical strategy for the entire Japan region - establishing thought leadership, building the long-term strategic case for Datadog, and expanding our footprint in the market.

  • GTM: Identifies industry specific trends and their impact and potential during Customers engagements, feeding the top-of-funnel for Product, GTM, BVA and Architecture teams. Co-create industry solutions via collaboration with Product SAs and Product Management.  
  • Leadership: Demonstrate Datadog's platform as well as thought leadership in Observability and Security, emphasizing our advanced solutions, industry best practices, and dedication to providing organizations with superior visibility and management of their at scale environments.

Participate in Executive Brief conversations in Datatadog’s Executive Briefing Center (EBC) with high profile customers and prospects about overall architecture, Observability Best Practices and industry trends.
  • Hiring: Assist leadership in recruiting and hiring of top talent for the Product Solutions Architecture and Field CTO teams.

  • Industry Experience: Strong experience of at least 15+ years with Enterprise architecture or Application architecture at scale and ability to map architectures to real world use cases, coupled with deep knowledge of the observability space, cloud, and technological shifts for customers in the Japan region. 
  • Strategic Thinker: Able to think long term and creatively about a wide variety of technical and business challenges

title: Field CTO (Japan)
description:
Field CTOはDatadogの社内プロダクトエキスパートとして、Technical Solutions（TS）チームを通じて、見込み顧客への提案活動および既存顧客の成功支援を行い、Datadogのグローバルな成長を支えています。

Field CTOは、Product Solutions Architecture（PSA）組織の一員として、技術的な知見をもとにお客様の経営層や意思決定者に対する信頼できるアドバイザーとして活動します。お客様のビジネス目標とDatadogのプロダクト戦略を結びつけ、デジタルトランスフォーメーションの推進と、双方にとっての持続的な成長の実現に貢献します。

Datadogのさらなる事業拡大に伴い、日本市場全体のGo-To-Market（GTM）における技術戦略をリードするField CTOポジションを新設します。本ポジションでは、業界におけるリーダーシップの確立（対外発信・エバンジェリズム）、中長期的な戦略的価値提案の推進、ならびに市場におけるプレゼンスの拡大を担っていただきます。

Datadogでは、オフィスカルチャーを大切にしています。オフィスで築かれる人間関係やコラボレーション、そしてそこから生まれる創造性に価値を置いています。当社はハイブリッドワーク体制を採用しており、Datadogの社員一人ひとりが自分に最適なワークライフバランスを実現できるようにしています。

title: FP&A Analyst
description:
About Datadog:

Datadog is the essential monitoring and security platform for cloud applications. We bring together end-to-end traces, metrics, and logs to make your applications, infrastructure, and third-party services entirely observable. These capabilities help businesses secure their systems, avoid downtime, and ensure customers are getting the best user experience.

The Team:

The Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A) team analyzes company financial data (revenue, customers, headcount, expenses, etc.) in order to support the business’ growth and success. Within FP&A, the R&D Finance team enables the financial strategy behind Datadog’s Engineering and Product organizations. We partner directly with technical leadership to drive decision-making around our most critical investments.

The Opportunity:

As a part of the R&D Finance team, this person will be key in supporting our product and engineering leadership team. Reporting to the Senior Manager, you will help create our annual budget and financial targets and work with operational leaders to support execution against our goals. Your work will be highly cross-functional and strategic, and you will play a pivotal role in connecting the dots across the organization through a financial lens, in order to help ensure operational alignment and inform decision making.

What You’ll Do:

  • Partner with senior business leaders to manage their departmental budgets on a regular basis, including but not limited to the company’s co-founder and CTO 
  • Manage financial forecasts and analytics, which include data across revenue, customers, product, company expenses, and headcount / workforce.
  • Help manage significant portions of the company’s spend, including but not limited to AI and GPU spend across the company.
  • Work on trend, ROI, and profitability analyses on both product and customer levels to support data-driven decision making
  • Work with finance management on quarterly Board materials, including coordination and consolidation across stakeholders
  • Assist in planning and budgeting cycles, ensuring consistency in tools, templates, and processes across the organization
  • Work on ad hoc projects and strategic initiatives for senior management, which may include assessing potential acquisition opportunities and/or negotiations with strategic partners like cloud vendors
  • Become proficient with various financial planning and business intelligence (BI) tools, including but not limited to Pigment, Tableau, and Metabase

Who You Are:

  • 2+ years of professional experience in FP&A / Strategic Finance, Corporate Finance, Investment Banking, and/or other related field
  • Bachelor's degree in finance, accounting, business, or economics
  • Mastery of Excel and PowerPoint with proven experience in building financial models and managing complex data
  • You are a clear, concise communicator and team player with a humble mindset and ‘can-do’ attitude 

Bonus Points:

  • Solid understanding of Pigment is a plus, but not required
  • Experience in or understanding of a consumption-based software business model
  • Proficiency in use of AI tools (e.g. ChatGPT, Claude)

Benefits and Growth: 

  • Generous and competitive benefits package
  • New hire stock equity (RSUs) and employee stock purchase plan
  • Continuous career development and pathing opportunities 
  • Product training to develop an in-depth understanding of our product and space
  • Friendly and inclusive workplace culture

At Datadog, we place value in our office culture - the relationships and collaboration it builds and the creativity it brings to the table. We operate as a hybrid workplace to ensure our Datadogs can create a work-life harmony that best fits them. This role will require you to work in the office 3 days per week, and flexible the remainder.

title: Front Desk Associate - Amsterdam
description:
At Datadog, our Office Operations teams run the day-to-day operations to keep our employees safe, happy, and productive, which means that every day is different. As a Front Desk Associate on Datadog’s Office Operations team, you will help create a welcoming, safe, and productive workplace for employees, candidates, visitors, and partners. You will support both front-of-house operations and the day-to-day facilities needs of the office, including reception, building access, mail and packages, workplace maintenance, supplies, vendor coordination, and employee events. You will work closely with the broader Office Operations team, building management, security, and facilities vendors to respond to workplace issues and keep the office running smoothly. This role offers opportunities to develop your facilities and workplace operations expertise while taking ownership of a wide range of on-site needs.

What You’ll Do:

  • Welcome employees, candidates, visitors, and partners, manage guest check-ins, and help create a positive front-desk experience.
  • Coordinate office access and badging, partnering with building security to support new hires, visitors, and employee requests.
  • Support day-to-day facilities operations by identifying and responding to workplace issues, coordinating repairs and maintenance, and partnering with building management and external vendors through resolution.
  • Manage incoming mail and packages, maintain reception and mailroom areas, and monitor and replenish office supplies.
  • Coordinate workplace vendors and related operational requirements, including certificates of insurance, and source new vendors, materials, or services as needed.
  • Partner with the Office Operations team to support employee requests and recurring and ad hoc office events, including monthly employee social events.

Who You Are:

  • You have 2–3 years of office operations, facilities, workplace, reception, administrative, or related experience, with experience supporting day-to-day facilities needs.
  • You communicate clearly and professionally in English and have entry-level Dutch language skills.
  • You are organized, detail-oriented, and comfortable taking ownership of facilities issues, coordinating multiple stakeholders, and following operational issues through resolution.
  • You build positive relationships and provide thoughtful customer service while working effectively with employees, building management, security, and external vendors.
  • You take initiative, solve problems resourcefully, and are comfortable taking a hands-on approach to workplace and facilities needs.
  • You are able to work in the office five days per week, participate in scheduled after-hours events, and meet the role’s required response expectations for urgent on-site workplace or facilities situations outside regular office hours.

title: GTM Strategy and Operations Associate
description:
We’re looking for an experienced Associate to join our growing GTM Strategy & Operations team. Our team solves complex problems that require insight, creativity, and execution through building scalable processes, tools, and systems for our rapidly growing global business. You will own the day-to-day management and strategy of the sales productivity tool ecosystem that powers our Sales and Customer Success organizations - including contact intelligence, outbound sequencing, and data enrichment platforms. Doing this successfully requires a deep understanding of the “day in the life” for field teams, strong vendor management skills, and the ability to translate business needs into tooling solutions that help Datadog grow 10x.

At Datadog, we place value in our office culture - the relationships and collaboration it builds and the creativity it brings to the table. We operate as a hybrid workplace to ensure our Datadogs can create a work-life harmony that best fits them.

You Will

  • Own the tool portfolio: Manage the strategy, lifecycle, and day-to-day administration of Datadog’s sales productivity tools, including contact intelligence, outbound sequencing, and data enrichment platforms 
  • Lead AI tooling strategy: Identify, evaluate, and pilot AI-powered tools and features that enhance sales productivity - from AI-assisted prospecting and enrichment to intelligent sequencing and personalization - and help define Datadog’s forward-looking AI tooling roadmap for the Sales and CS organizations
  • Drive vendor performance: Manage vendor relationships, contract renewals, and commercial negotiations in partnership with Legal, Finance, and Procurement - including benchmarking tools against alternatives and driving competitive pricing
  • Measure impact: Define and track success metrics across all managed tools (e.g., adoption rates, data quality, pipeline influenced) and use findings to make data-driven consolidation, expansion, or replacement decisions
  • Partner with the field: Work closely with Sales and Customer Success to understand workflow needs and translate them into tooling improvements that directly improve rep productivity
  • Lead enablement: Own tool onboarding, change management, and adoption programs in collaboration with the Sales Enablement team to ensure field teams get maximum value from every platform
  • Evaluate new tools: Lead structured vendor evaluation processes (e.g., RFPs, pilots, POCs) for emerging platforms, including building business cases and presenting investment recommendations to GTM leadership
  • Ensure seamless integration: Collaborate with GTM Systems to maintain and improve integrations between sales productivity tools, Salesforce CRM, and the broader GTM tech stack
  • Set the standard: Build and enforce governance frameworks, acceptable use policies, and data hygiene standards across all managed tools to ensure consistency and compliance

Requirements

  • Experience: 2-4+ years of experience in GTM Strategy & Operations, management consulting, banking, analytics, or a similar analytical field, ideally within SaaS or high‑growth B2B technology.
  • AI innovation: Strong interest in exploring, launching, and scaling new GTM AI technologies to improve sales development productivity and effectiveness
  • Vendor management: Proven ability to own vendor relationships and contribute to commercial negotiations, including renewals and expansions
  • Tool fluency: Hands-on familiarity with the B2B sales technology landscape, including contact intelligence (e.g., ZoomInfo, Cognism), outbound sequencing (e.g., Groove, Salesloft, Outreach), and data enrichment tools (e.g., Clay, Clearbit, Crunchbase)
  • Cross-functional collaboration: Strong track record of partnering with Sales and CS teams to identify pain points and drive tooling solutions from requirements through rollout
  • Analytical mindset: Comfortable measuring tool adoption, ROI, and usage trends - and communicating those findings clearly to senior stakeholders
  • CRM knowledge: Solid understanding of Salesforce CRM and how sales productivity tools integrate into the broader GTM tech stack
  • Communication: Effective communicator, both written and verbal, with strong attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously
  • Ownership mentality: Self-starter who takes initiative, operates independently, and drives projects through to completion without heavy oversight

Datadog values people from all walks of life. We understand not everyone will meet all the above qualifications on day one. That's okay. If you’re passionate about technology and want to grow your skills, we encourage you to apply.

  • AI passion: Stays current on the latest AI news, has a passion for experimentation, has fully integrated AI into professional workflows, and vibe codes on the weekend
  • Broader stack exposure: Familiarity with adjacent tools such as buyer intent platforms (e.g., Bombora, G2) or conversation intelligence (e.g., Gong)
  • Technical aptitude: Working knowledge of APIs and how sales tools connect to CRM systems and data infrastructure
  • Full-funnel experience: Experience supporting tool adoption across Sales Development, Account Executive, and Customer Success teams

title: GTM Strategy/Operations Associate
description:
The GTM Strategy & Operations Associate will join a global team focused on driving Datadog’s next phase of growth. In this role, you will identify opportunities for revenue growth, evaluate business tradeoffs, and partner with senior leaders to shape go-to-market strategy. You will drive key planning processes, including capacity and quota planning, optimization and expansion strategies, and KPI design and measurement. You will also lead strategic and operational initiatives that improve execution while building experience across complex, high-impact business challenges.

At Datadog, we place value in our office culture - the relationships and collaboration it builds and the creativity it brings to the table. We operate as a hybrid workplace to ensure our Datadogs can create a work-life harmony that best fits them.

What You’ll Do:

  • Develop short- and long-term go-to-market strategies by identifying growth opportunities, setting business priorities, and aligning sales and growth targets
  • Own quota planning for the global Sales organization, including building and maintaining quota models, adapting them to organizational changes, and driving stakeholder alignment
  • Analyze sales and go-to-market data to identify trends and channel efficiency, and develop models that inform planning, quota setting, and strategic decisions
  • Partner with Sales and other go-to-market leaders to shape strategic priorities, translate future-state goals into actionable plans, and execute key initiatives
  • Build dashboards and define KPIs that translate complex data into actionable insights for business leaders
  • Lead and support high-priority cross-functional initiatives that improve execution and accelerate revenue growth

Who You Are:

  • You have 2–4 years of experience in go-to-market, growth, or revenue strategy; management consulting; investment banking or equity research; business analysis; or a related field
  • You can break down complex or ambiguous business problems, identify key tradeoffs, and develop clear, actionable recommendations
  • You have strong quantitative modeling and analytical skills, with attention to detail and the ability to communicate key insights to senior business stakeholders
  • You communicate clearly in writing and verbally, including synthesizing complex concepts and developing presentations for senior and executive audiences
  • You have demonstrated the ability to own multiple projects and collaborate cross-functionally with stakeholders across functions such as Sales, Marketing, Strategy, and Product
  • You have experience with, or an interest in learning, business intelligence and data analysis tools such as Tableau, Looker, Metabase, SQL, or Python; experience with Sales or Customer Success strategy, SaaS, or high-tech businesses is a plus

description:
The Enterprise IT Support team is responsible for the hardware and software that Datadog employees around the world use on a daily basis to successfully do their jobs.

description:

DatadogのMid-Market Salesチームでは、従業員数1,000～5,000名規模の企業をターゲットに、新規顧客の獲得を通じて事業成長を支えるアカウントエグゼクティブ（AE）を募集しています。

description:
As an Account Executive on our Mid-Market Sales team (targeting customers 1,000 to 5,000 employees in size), you will assist in Datadog’s overall business growth by strategically engaging and closing net-new customers across mid-to-large size organizations. Sellers follow a well-defined methodology, collaborate with internal stakeholders & partner ecosystem, identify the customer's unique needs, and clearly convey the value of the Datadog solution. Mid-Market AE’s have the opportunity to grow their careers in Sales and continue contributing to Datadog team success.

At Datadog, we place value in our office culture - the relationships and collaboration it builds and the creativity it brings to the table. We operate as a hybrid workplace to ensure our Datadogs can create a work-life harmony that best fits them.

What You’ll Do:

  • Focus entirely on net-new logo acquisition
  • Manage the full sales cycle, including negotiations and on-site technical demonstrations
  • Identify robust set of business drivers behind all opportunities
  • Develop a deep comprehension of customer's business
  • Strategically prospect into Chief Technology Officers, Engineering/IT Leaders, and technical end users (SRE, DevOps, DevSecOps)
  • Multi-thread into different departments of a complex organization
  • Collaborate with Sales Development Representatives, Partners, & Marketing to drive top of funnel activity
  • Apply modern sales strategy with real time signals and research using tools Sales Navigator & Demandbase

Datadog values people from all walks of life. We understand not everyone will meet all the above qualifications on day one. That's okay. If you’re passionate about technology and want to grow your experience, we encourage you to apply.

Who You Are:

  • Curious and motivated to understand emerging technologies and how they intersect with core business drivers.
  • Experienced in hunting, strategically mapping and breaking into net new logos
  • Strong Pipeline Generation skills, bold in front of customers and creative in your pursuits 
  • Role requires regular travel to client sites, within your area and other regions, using various modes of transportation (car, train, air), depending on business needs.

 Benefits and Growth:

  • High income earning opportunities based on self performance
  • Opportunity for Presidents Club
  • New hire stock equity (RSU) and employee stock purchase plan (ESPP)

  • Both Technical and Sales Methodology enablement
  • Intra-departmental mentor and buddy program for in-house networking

title: Product Management Intern
description:
Datadog is seeking curious, driven interns to join our Product Management team and help build products that improve how engineers monitor and understand their systems. As a Product Management Intern, you’ll work alongside Engineering, Design, and Product Marketing throughout the product development lifecycle, contributing to meaningful initiatives and real product decisions. You’ll gain hands-on experience building for highly technical customers while developing your product thinking, technical communication, and cross-functional collaboration skills. With Datadog’s platform processing over 100 trillion events per day across 30,000+ customers in a multi-cloud environment, you’ll gain direct exposure to large-scale, real-time systems built by engineers, for engineers.

At Datadog, we place value in our office culture - the relationships and collaboration it builds and the creativity it brings to the table. We operate as a hybrid workplace to ensure our Datadogs can create a work-life harmony that best fits them.

 

What You’ll Do:

  • Conduct customer discovery conversations and gather feedback to better understand user needs
  • Drive product initiatives from concept through launch alongside Engineering, Design, and Product Marketing teams
  • Translate customer and business needs into clear product requirements and engineering priorities
  • Analyze customer feedback, product data, and market insights to help inform product decisions
  • Prepare and deliver technical product demonstrations and communication materials
  • Develop technical understanding of Datadog’s observability platform and cloud infrastructure products

 

Who You Are:

  • Targeting a 2027 full-time graduation
  • Pursuing a degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field
  • Prior internship, project, or academic experience in product management, software engineering, or another product-focused technical role
  • Exposure to B2B software product development and ability to communicate technical concepts clearly while collaborating with engineers and other technical stakeholders
  • Interested in emerging technologies, including AI-powered developer tools and cloud technologies
  • Available to complete a 6-month internship beginning in February, March, April, May, or June 2027 (we are unable to accommodate internships starting at any other time)

Datadog values people from all walks of life. We know not everyone will meet all the above qualifications on day one. That’s okay. If you’re passionate about technology and want to grow your experience, we encourage you to apply.

 

Benefits and Growth:

  • Work on meaningful technical challenges alongside engineers across the globe
  • Participate in mentorship and buddy programs designed to support learning and development

title: Research Science Intern (PhD)
location: New York, New York, USA; Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania, USA
description:
Datadog AI Research — Scholars Program with Carnegie Mellon University

Datadog AI Research (DAIR) is partnering with Carnegie Mellon University to support a small number of PhD students working on open research problems grounded by ongoing efforts at Datadog/DAIR. 

You will frame a problem, run your own experiments, and write up what you find, with compute and data at a scale most academic labs cannot provide.  You will collaborate with colleagues working on the same questions.

 

The Lab And The Research:

DAIR is an industrial research lab motivated by practical challenges in observability and software operation: detecting and diagnosing failures, understanding complex production environments, and helping engineers operate software more effectively. The lab focuses on creating specialized foundation models, post-training and evaluating AI agents, and building frontier-scale machine learning systems. By combining fundamental research with Datadog's large-scale, real-world data and infrastructure, the lab develops new AI capabilities and translates them into practical systems with meaningful impact.

Internship projects are shaped with your DAIR mentor and your CMU faculty advisor. You do not need prior experience with observability, monitoring, or infrastructure.

 

What You'll Do:

  • Own a research project end to end: framing the question, running the experiments, writing it up
  • Work directly with a DAIR mentor engaged in the same problem, and stay connected to your advisor and lab
  • Publish, and use the work toward your dissertation
  • See research reach production, when it works

 

Who You Are:

  • Currently enrolled in a PhD program at Carnegie Mellon in machine learning, computer science, statistics, or a related field
  • Depth in at least one area relevant to the research above
  • Comfort running real experiments — training models, working with GPUs, reading and reimplementing recent papers
  • Evidence you can do research: conference or workshop papers, preprints, open-source contributions, or a lab project you can discuss in depth
  • Research taste. You can explain why a problem matters and what would change if it were solved.
  • Honest empiricism. You report the ablation that didn't work.
  • Support from your faculty advisor.

 

Not Required:

  • A long publication record. How you think matters more than how much you've published.
  • Observability, monitoring, or SRE background.
  • A perfect match to the areas above.

 

Datadog values people from all walks of life. We know not everyone will meet all the above qualifications on day one. That’s okay. If you’re passionate about technology and want to grow your experience, we encourage you to apply.

 

This job is available in various departments within our company; to conform to US export control regulations, some of these roles may require candidates to be eligible for any required authorizations from the US government.

 

If possible, please apply using your personal email address instead of your university email address.

 

Students can sign up for a free Datadog Pro account to learn more about our platform and products.

description:
Datadog Sales Engineers help qualify and close opportunities with customers and partners by providing technical expertise through sales presentations, product demonstrations, and supporting technical evaluations (POCs). As a Sales Engineer 2, you will independently own technical engagements throughout the sales cycle, partnering closely with Customer Success Managers to align customer business objectives with Datadog's platform. You will also collaborate across Engineering, Support, Product, and various other cross-functional teams to resolve customer concerns, advocate for customer needs, and serve as a trusted technical advisor throughout the evaluation process.

If you want to join a friendly, passionate team with limitless potential, we'd love to meet you!

At Datadog, we place value in our office culture, the relationships and collaboration it builds, and the creativity it brings to the table. We operate as a hybrid workplace to ensure our Datadogs can create a work-life harmony that best fits them.

  • Partner with the Customer Success team to articulate Datadog's value proposition, vision, and technical strategy throughout the sales cycle.
  • Deliver tailored product demonstrations and technical presentations that map customer challenges to Datadog solutions.
  • Assist with technical discovery by identifying customer business objectives, technical challenges, and success criteria.
  • Own technical evaluations (POCs) from kickoff through successful completion, proactively driving customer engagement and removing technical blockers.
  • Continually expand your expertise across Datadog's platform while building competitive knowledge and technical credibility.
  • Develop trusted relationships with customer technical stakeholders, communicating business value to buying teams and helping position accounts for a successful long-term partnership that sets the stage for future growth.
  • Contribute to team success by sharing best practices, mentoring newer Sales Engineers, and supporting enablement initiatives.
  • Think creatively to solve a wide variety of technical challenges throughout the sales cycle.

Who You Are:

  • Ideally 1.5 years or greater as a Sales Engineer or in a comparable customer-facing technical role
  • Strong understanding of cloud infrastructure, modern application architectures, observability, and/or DevOps technologies
  • Experience with modern infrastructure technologies, such as cloud platforms, containers, Kubernetes, microservices, networking, and/or operating systems
  • Able to translate technical capabilities into meaningful business outcomes for customers
  • Comfortable independently leading technical presentations, product demonstrations, and evaluations
  • Skilled at navigating multiple customer stakeholders while managing several active evaluations simultaneously
  • Effective communicator and collaborator with both technical practitioners (Developers, SREs, Platform Engineers, Operations teams) and business stakeholders
  • Curious, adaptable, and eager to continually learn and expand technical expertise
  • Enjoys a hybrid office culture and spending time in-person at our Denver office
  • Able to sit for up to 4 hours while traveling to and from client sites
  • Able to travel via auto, train, or air up to 25% of the time

title: Sales Engineer - Enterprise
description:
As an Enterprise Sales Engineer, you'll partner with Sales to help customers understand the value of Datadog and how it solves their most important technical and business challenges. You'll lead technical evaluations, deliver compelling demos, and guide customers through the journey from discovery to successful adoption.

You'll act as a trusted advisor, bridging business goals with technical solutions, and play a key role in winning new business and expanding existing accounts.

At Datadog, we place value in our office culture - the relationships and collaboration it builds and the creativity it brings to the table. We operate as a hybrid workplace to ensure our Datadogs can create a work-life harmony that best fits them.

What You’ll Do:

  • Own the sales process in partnership with Account Executives by leading and shaping the technical strategy across opportunities from PG to Closed Won
  • Lead customer discovery to uncover technical challenges, business goals, and success criteria, then translate those needs into tailored Datadog solutions
  • Deliver engaging product demos, technical presentations, and workshops that connect platform capabilities to customer outcomes
  • Project manage technical evaluations (POVs) end-to-end: scoping use cases and requirements, defining success criteria, building a project plan with clear timelines, and holding all participants accountable to the process
  • Identify and cultivate technical champions within customer accounts, empowering them to advocate for Datadog adoption and drive consensus internally
  • Participate actively in structured product and engineering field feedback sessions, serving as the technical voice of the customer to help shape product direction
  • Maintain operational excellence by ensuring activity, deal progress, and customer interactions are accurately documented and up to date in related systems 
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with Product, Support, and GTM teams to address customer needs and resolve technical blockers

Who You Are: 

  • 5+ years of experience in Sales Engineering, Solutions Engineering, or a technical customer-facing role within an enterprise environment
  • Skilled at navigating multi-stakeholder environments and adapting communication style to technical, business, and executive audiences
  • Proficient background in public cloud (AWS, Azure, GCP), Kubernetes, APM/tracing, security, developer experience, observability
  • Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts to a range of audiences
  • A consultative approach to problem-solving and customer engagement
  • Ability to manage multiple opportunities and priorities in a fast-paced environment
  • Growth mindset by embracing change and AI tools
  • Willingness to travel as needed to support customer engagements

Datadog values people from all walks of life. We understand not everyone will meet all the above qualifications on day one. That's okay. If you’re passionate about technology and want to grow your skills, we encourage you to apply.

  • Continuous professional development, product training, and career pathing

title: Sales Revenue Analyst - NYC
description:
Datadog is the monitoring and security platform for cloud applications. Our SaaS product is used by organizations of all sizes across a wide range of industries to enable digital transformation, cloud migration, and infrastructure monitoring of our customers’ entire technology stack, allowing for seamless collaboration and problem-solving among Dev, Ops and Security teams globally. Given the resilience of cloud technologies and importance placed today in digital operations and agility, Datadog continues to innovate and is well positioned for the long term. 

Datadog’s Revenue Operations  & Finance team is in a phase of dynamic growth, committed to relentless enhancement and strategic problem-solving to drive business success. The Sales Revenue team at Datadog is instrumental in fueling our rapid growth trajectory. Collaborating seamlessly across various departments, we offer comprehensive commercial, operational, and analytical support to drive Datadog's business and Sales organization forward with unparalleled efficiency and agility. In this pivotal role, you will thrive within  an inclusive environment, collaborating closely with a diverse array of talented individuals who share a deep passion for innovation.Your primary focus will involve tackling intricate business challenges in tandem with Sales Leadership, Finance, Growth, GTM, Operations, and other essential stakeholders, fostering seamless synergy and driving impactful outcomes. 

We are seeking  a highly skilled Sales Revenue Analyst to join our team in Boston, MA or New York, NY. Your role will involve providing critical support and vision to our revenue team by overseeing the meticulous calculation of global sales team commissions and accurate recognition of new business revenue as we strategically expand into new markets and drive revenue growth. 

At Datadog, we place value in our office culture - the relationships and collaboration it builds and the creativity it brings to the table. We operate as a hybrid workplace to ensure our Datadogs can create a work-life harmony that best fits them.

What You’ll Do:

  • Spearhead the strategic ownership, iterative refinement, and optimization of monthly commission strategies across diverse verticals, ensuring alignment with organizational objectives and driving performance excellence from our Go-to-Market motion 
  • Lead the conceptualization and execution of innovative, cross-functional solutions aimed at scaling Sales Revenue operations to new heights of efficiency and effectiveness
  • Collaborate on the customization of analytical frameworks to evaluate the business impact of existing incentive-based compensation plans, delivering actionable insights to enhance refinement and improvement efforts 
  • Conduct comprehensive analysis of the Deal Close process to ensure the efficacy and soundness of new commercial sales. Meticulously review deal structures, financial terms, and product pricing with precision
  • Establish and maintain a robust reporting infrastructure for core sales processes, encompassing quota allocation, compensation plans, coverage and territory management, and real-time performance monitoring to drive informed decision-making.
  • Partner with Strategy and Growth teams in the development of scalable sales compensation structures and initiatives, fostering alignment with board-level growth objectives
  • Grow your technical and functional expertise in Salesforce and auxiliary SaaS systems including: Tableau, CaptivateIQ, Jira, Clari, Confluence
  • Forge close partnerships with Datadog’s senior leadership to evaluate, design, and operationalize transformative sales strategy programs, fostering organizational agility and competitive advantage
  • Contribute to strategic planning and process improvement initiatives aimed at elevating the quality and architecture of product usage, revenue, and CRM dashboards, thereby enhancing operational rigor and unlocking advanced reporting capabilities

Who You Are:

  • 2-4 years of experience in revenue, sales operations, FP&A, business analyst or consulting roles demonstrating a solid foundation in finance and business principles
  • Advanced Excel skills to manage and analyze large data sets, enabling effective management and analysis of large datasets with precision and accuracy
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, coupled with the ability to swiftly establish trust, credibility, and influence across diverse stakeholders
  • Familiarity with Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) business models, showcasing an understanding of recurring revenue dynamics and subscription-based businesses
  • Demonstrated ability to think strategically about complex issues, showcasing adept problem-solving skills and analytical prowess
  • Excellent interpersonal skills, with a track record of effectively presenting to teams of diverse functions and hierarchical levels, fostering collaboration and understanding 
  • Proven capability in project ownership and delivery, collaborating closely with cross-functional teams to manage stakeholders, coordinate activities, and prioritize tasks, ensuring successful project outcomes

Bonus Points:

  • Experience working with compensation & business automation tools 
  • Prior experience in a high-growth SaaS company and/or multi-national public company,demonstrating adaptability and ability to thrive in dynamic environments
  • Familiarity with SaaS company economics, deal structuring, and revenue models, indicating a comprehensive understanding of subscription-based business models. 
  • Experience working in Mac OS
  • Proficiency in  Salesforce CRM, Google Sheets, and Jira
  • Familiarity with Tableau, Metabase, and (or) other business intelligence systems
  • Experience with advanced analytics to deliver forecasts and/or intuitive models
  • Previous experience in client-facing role or working with C-suite executives

title: Software Engineering Intern
description:
We’re looking for Software Engineering Interns to help build and scale the systems that power Datadog’s observability and security platform. Interns contribute directly to real-world engineering challenges across backend, frontend, infrastructure, data engineering, and developer tooling while working alongside experienced engineers and mentors. You’ll help design, build, and improve systems that process and analyze massive volumes of metrics, logs, and application data in real time. Whether you’re interested in distributed systems, Kubernetes, AI-powered products like Bits AI, or developer platform tooling, you’ll work on meaningful projects that deliver impact for customers at global scale.

At Datadog, we place value in our office culture - the relationships and collaboration it builds and the creativity it brings to the table. We operate as a hybrid workplace to ensure our Datadogs can create a work-life harmony that best fits them. 

 

What You’ll Do:

  • Contribute to production systems that process and analyze large-scale observability and application data in real time
  • Build and improve distributed systems across backend infrastructure, developer platforms, and cloud-native services
  • Help identify and solve performance, reliability, and scalability challenges in critical services supporting Datadog’s growing customer base
  • Own and deliver technical projects from design through deployment with guidance from experienced engineers and mentors
  • Develop technical expertise through hands-on experience with technologies such as Kubernetes, distributed systems, and cloud-native infrastructure
  • Collaborate with fellow interns, mentors, and engineers while building software that delivers impact at global scale

 

Who You Are:

  • Expected to graduate in 2027 with a degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field from a university in Spain
  • Demonstrate strong computer science fundamentals, including data structures, algorithms, and software design
  • Comfortable coding in one or more programming languages and excited to use AI-assisted tools to enhance software development and problem solving
  • Have experience using AI coding tools or a strong interest in learning how to use them effectively while exploring how AI can improve engineering practices and products
  • Available to complete a full-time or part-time internship beginning in February 2027. At this time, we are only able to support internship start dates in February 2027.

Datadog values people from all walks of life. We know not everyone will meet all the above qualifications on day one. That’s okay. If you’re passionate about technology and want to grow your experience, we encourage you to apply.

 

Benefits and Growth:

  • Work on meaningful technical challenges alongside engineers across the globe
  • Participate in mentorship and buddy programs designed to support learning and development
  • Join an in-person intern cohort and expand your network through engineering talks, social events, and community engagement opportunities throughout your internship
  • Receive relocation support and travel benefits where applicable
  • Enjoy office perks including snacks, drinks, and catered lunches on Monday, Wednesday, and Friday

Our Strategic Account Executives target and close new business with Datadog’s largest, most strategic customers and prospects. In this role you’ll be focused on uncovering the pain points organizations face as they operate in or migrate to a cloud environment at scale as well as delivering the appropriate Datadog solution.

At Datadog, we place value in our office culture - the relationships and collaboration it builds and the creativity it brings to the table. We operate as a hybrid workplace to ensure our Datadogs can create a work-life harmony that best fits them.

What You’ll Do:

  • Prospect into large Fortune 1000 companies while running an efficient sales process
  • Maintain, build and own specific relationship maps for your territory including existing relationships and aspirational contacts
  • Develop a deep comprehension of customer's business
  • Negotiate favorable pricing and business terms with large commercial enterprises by selling value and ROI
  • Handle existing customer expectations while expanding reach and depth into assigned territory
  • Demonstrate resourcefulness when faced with challenges that defy easy solution
  • Have intuitive sense of necessary steps to close business and gain customer validation
  • Identify robust set of business drivers behind all opportunities
  • Ensure high forecasting accuracy and consistency

Who You Are: 

  • Someone with 5+ years closing experience (mix of field selling within mid-market and enterprise)
  • Driven and have met/exceeded direct sales goals of 1M+ and operated with an average deal size of $100k+
  • Able to demonstrate methodology to prospect and build pipeline on your own
  • Experienced in working for an innovative tech company (SaaS, IT infrastructure or similar preferred)
  • Experienced in selling into large Fortune 1000 companies with the ability to win new logos
  • Role requires regular travel to client sites, within your area and other regions, using various modes of transportation (car, train, air), depending on business needs

Datadog values people from all walks of life. We understand not everyone will meet all the above qualifications on day one. That's okay. If you’re passionate about technology and want to grow your skills, we encourage you to apply.

Benefits and Growth: 

  • High income earning opportunities based on self performance
  • New hire stock equity (RSU) and employee stock purchase plan (ESPP)
  • Continuous professional development, product training, and career pathing 
  • Sales training in MEDDIC and Command of the Message 
  • Intra-departmental mentor and buddy program for in-house networking 
  • An inclusive company culture, opportunity to join our Community Guilds
  • Generous and competitive medical benefits package
  • Retirement savings match
  • Pet adoption and insurance program

Benefits and Growth listed above may vary based on the country of your employment and the nature of your employment with Datadog.

#LI-Hybrid

About Datadog: 

Datadog is the leading observability and security platform for the AI era, providing businesses with unified visibility across the technology stack to manage complexity at scale. It brings applications, infrastructure, data, models, and security into one place, using AI to detect and resolve issues before they impact customers. Trusted globally by Fortune 500 companies and high-growth AI leaders, Datadog enables businesses to move faster with clarity and confidence. Learn more about #DatadogLife on Instagram, LinkedIn, and Datadog Learning Center.

description:

私たちは、テクノロジーに対する強い情熱を持ち、チャレンジングな売上目標を達成できる経験豊富なFederal（中央省庁）セールスエグゼクティブを募集しています。Datadogがより大きな市場へ進出し、Public Sector（公共分野）エンタープライズセグメントへの支援を本格化する中で、このチームは組織成長を牽引する重要な役割を担います。本ポジションは、将来性の高いテリトリーにおいて新たな中央省庁・政府機関を開拓すると同時に、ハイブリッド環境からクラウドへ移行中の顧客とも関われる、非常に魅力的な機会です。

  • 中央省庁、政府機関に対するプロスペクティングおよび、効率的なセールスプロセスの遂行

  • クロージングに必要なステップを直感的に把握し、顧客の合意を獲得
  • すべての商談における主要なビジネスドライバーの特定
  • 高い精度と一貫性を持ったフォーキャスト管理

  • 自らプロスペクティングし、パイプラインを構築できる明確なセールスメソドロジーをお持ちの方
  • SaaS、ITインフラ等の革新的なテック企業での勤務経験（尚可）

  • 新入社員への株式付与（RSU / 譲渡制限付株式ユニット）および従業員株式購入制度（ESPP）
  • プレジデント・クラブへの参加機会
  • 継続的な専門能力開発、製品トレーニング、キャリアパスの提供 
  • MEDDICとCommand of Messageに関する丁寧な営業研修 
  • 社内ネットワーク構築のためのメンターおよびバディ・プログラム 
  • インクルーシブな企業文化、コミュニティ・ギルドへの参加機会
  • 幅広く手厚い医療関連の福利厚生制度

title: Account Executive
description:
Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale — unleashing the potential of businesses and people. The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500, brings together the precision of search and the intelligence of AI to enable everyone to accelerate the results that matter. By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data — securing and protecting private information more effectively — Elastic’s complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI.

What Is The Role

Elastic, the Search Analytics company, is seeking a dynamic Enterprise Account Executive. To excel as an Account Executive at Elastic, you need a blend of high-level technical curiosity and the gravitas of a value-based seller. Because Elastic isn't just a "product" but a versatile search, observability, and security platform, the role requires moving beyond simple transactions to solving complex data problems.

We are seeking an Enterprise Account Executive working a set of new and existing customers . In this role, you will own the full sales cycle—from cold outreach to close—focused entirely on acquiring new logos in an assigned territory. If you excel at navigating new organizations and demonstrating the value of advanced search technology to stakeholders, this is your opportunity to drive our next phase of growth.

What You Will Be Doing

  • Drive Adoption: Fuel the adoption of Elastic’s AI-powered search solutions, Observability and Security solutions within new enterprise accounts while deepening engagement with existing ones.
  • Be a Trusted Advisor: Assist users and customers in harnessing the full power of search analytics to transform data into actionable insights.
  • Domain & cloud acumen: Position Elastic as the Search AI platform of choice by speaking fluently about cloud economics, usage-based pricing, and modern data architectures.
  • Solve Complex Problems: Move beyond simple transactions to address the intricate data challenges our customers face.
  • Champion Open Source: Articulate the value of our advanced commercial features while advocating for our Open-Source offerings.
  • Identify New Use Cases: Showcase how Elastic’s solutions enable users to work more efficiently and intelligently.
  • Strategic Planning: Develop comprehensive business plans leveraging community, customer, and partner ecosystems to drive significant territory growth.
  • Navigate Sales Cycles: Proactively identify new opportunities and successfully manage complex sales cycles.
  • Deep discovery & qualification: Uncover pain, business impact, budget, and decision criteria using frameworks like MEDDPICC so you chase only the highest-confidence deals.
  • Cross-functional partnership: Work hand-in-glove with Solutions Architects, Customer Success, Marketing, and RevOps to accelerate deals and drive exceptional customer outcomes.

What You Bring

  • The Right Blend: A combination of high-level technical curiosity and the grit of a value-based seller.
  • Proven Track Record: Success in SaaS subscription sales in Enterprise accounts, evidenced by overachievement.
  • Mindset: Pure focus on acquiring new logos with a record to prove it. 
  • Value Storytelling: The ability to craft tailored narratives that link Elastic’s technical capabilities (Search, Observability, Security) to measurable business outcomes like revenue gain or risk mitigation is critical.
  • Executive negotiation & closing: Lead high-stakes contract and pricing discussions
  • Technical & cloud fluency: Comfortable discussing a broad range of technical topics including security, observability, vector/traditional search, and cloud cost optimization.
  • Relationship Building: Adept at establishing credibility with both technical developers and executive leadership.
  • Mutual deal strategy & forecast accuracy: Consistent, predictable and accurate sales forecasting skills. Collaborate with customers to build formal close plans and keep your CRM up to date.
  • Ability to create alignment across teams to accelerate deals
  • AI Mindset: Use new technologies for performance advantage and deal structuring
  • Open-Source Appreciation: Enthusiasm for the Open-Source model and the community relying on our solutions

Core platform infrastructure is provisioned centrally; you'll help configure HR-specific pipelines and dbt modeling work on top of it, in partnership with our data scientist, and stand up recruiting reporting and insights as the first production use case on the new stack. This role reports directly to the Director of HR Analytics, with high visibility into architecture and stakeholder-facing decisions from day one.

Your mission is to move the organization away from manual reporting and toward a mature, self-service environment where senior stakeholders get decision-ready answers, not just data.

What You Will Be Doing

Build and Deploy Scalable Analytics

  • Build and maintain data pipelines in BigQuery/dbt, on infrastructure provisioned by the central data platform team, that link HR data across the employee lifecycle (Workday, Greenhouse, Qualtrics, ServiceNow), so we can trace how hiring decisions affect long-term engagement and retention.
  • Support and enhance the AI-powered analytics user experience.
  • Develop scalable, self-service dashboards that reduce time spent on reactive, one-off data requests.
  • Implement data governance practices (access controls, validation, documentation) in line with team standards for sensitive HR and compensation data.
  • Build data proficiency across the broader HR team as part of the shift to self-service.

 

Recruiting Reporting and Insight Engine

  • Automate recurring recruiting reports to eliminate manual data wrangling.
  • Translate talent data into insights that identify pipeline bottlenecks, improve candidate experience, and improve hiring efficiency.
  • Monitor recruiting data for anomalies and build validation checks to establish one version of the truth across systems.

  • 2+ years of hands-on experience building and maintaining data pipelines in Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
  • Strong SQL and Python skills.
  • Direct experience extracting and modeling data from at least one major HRIS or ATS platform (e.g., Workday, Greenhouse) via its reporting or API layer. General dashboard-level reporting experience is not a substitute.
  • Demonstrated ability to build custom dashboards and data visualizations using standard BI platforms (e.g., Looker, Tableau) or code-based environments (e.g., Python, Streamlit, Plotly).

What You Bring

  • Strong storytelling and presentation skills for both VP/executive and non-technical audiences.
  • Experience working across geographies and time zones, tailoring insights to diverse audiences.
  • A point of view on AI/LLM-based analytics tools and how they simplify insight delivery – direct experience implementing one is a plus.

description:

The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500, brings together the precision of search and the intelligence of AI to enable everyone to accelerate the results that matter. By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data — securing and protecting private information more effectively — Elastic’s complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI.

What is The Role

We are looking for an innovative and curious Corporate Counsel to help shape how Elastic’s technologies are built, protected, and brought to market. Elastic is distributed-by-design  and this role can be located in the United States or Canada, reporting to the Vice President of Legal Innovation (Product, IP, Marketing) with dotted line supervision by the Director of Legal Innovation. You will work alongside product and engineering teams from initial ideation through product launch, supporting legal design advice on features at the cutting edge of enterprise technology, helping the company to scale at velocity. The role assists with day-to-day in-house innovation and patent prosecution management.  It carries a broad set of additional product counsel responsibilities collaborating with other legal team members to address AI governance, open-source licensing, dependency management, trademark and brand protection, baseline trade compliance backup, and commercial enablement. We're looking for a resourceful early career attorney with a roll-up-your-sleeves demeanor and the ability to navigate the intersection of law and emerging technology.

What You Will Be Doing

This is a dynamic role for a proactive advocate who enjoys finding solutions and bringing velocity to quality outcomes. In this capacity, you will:

Patent Prosecution & Invention Harvesting: Support Elastic's day-to-day patent prosecution and innovation motions. Develop a deep working knowledge of Elastic's product technology and roadmap. Assist in operating the invention harvesting and patent intake program by working with other Elasticians to identify innovative ideas, evaluate inventions for patentability, and prepare or review patent disclosures. You will support and assist more senior legal team members and stakeholders in working with outside patent counsel, help identify and prioritize IP filings in line with portfolio strategy, and support value creation and efficiencies in IP portfolio management.

IP Portfolio Management: Working closely with the Director of Legal for Product and IP, help manage Elastic's global patent, copyright, and trademark portfolios, including trademark monitoring and clearance, copyright registrations, and tracking all filing, prosecution, and renewal deadlines across jurisdictions.

Brand Protection & Enforcement: Support IP enforcement strategies by assisting with domain name disputes, social media takedowns, and coordination with vendors and outside counsel on pre-litigation disputes and assertions.

Product Regulatory Governance & Product Launch Readiness: Coordinate with cross-functional team members, including Legal Privacy and Commercial, Information Security, and IT to support our Product build and release functions.  Support ongoing improvements to related internal guidelines as necessary to ensure all Elasticians are operating efficiently and effectively within the productization and go-to-market functions.

Open-Source & Product Counseling: Assist in managing day-to-day open-source software licensing and compliance programs, ensuring inbound third-party dependencies align with our outbound strategy. Support in the creation of advice and assistance for engineering and product management teams on intellectual property rights, open-source licensing, AI modelopen weight licensing, dependencies generally, and data collection/usage risks.

Commercial Contracts & Playbooks: Review, research, and prepare first drafts of commercial contract clauses related to AI, IP, Product, dependencies, and open-source software—including data rights and warranties.  Support in the updating of legal playbooks to reflect shifting industry standards with the Commercial Legal Team.

Legal Research & Diligence: Support in and conduct factual and legal research, organize complex documentation for technology partnerships, M&A diligence, and legal disputes in a distributed environment.

Trade Compliance Support: Develop a foundational understanding of Elastic's product and its technical intricacies to provide backup support to our core trade compliance team. Learn to analyze and help apply export laws, such as the Export Administration Regulations (EAR), specifically as they relate to our product capabilities and software portfolio.

What You Bring

  • Experience: 2–5+ years of experience in patent prosecution and/or litigation and intellectual property or product law, preferably with exposure to the software industry. SaaS, enterprise data platforms, or open-source products.
  • Technical Background: A bachelor's or advanced degree in a science or engineering field. Experience in or academic background in software engineering is a strong plus.
  • Credentials: Admission to the US or Canadian Patent Bar (registration number required). A JD from a US law school or LLB from a Canadian law school preferred, but patent agents are eligible. 
  • Patent Proficiency: Demonstrated experience drafting, reviewing, or managing patent applications, with the ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear patent claims and legal analysis.
  • Technical Curiosity: A demonstrated interest in Generative Artificial Intelligence and the legal frameworks governing code and data.
  • Problem-Solving: A self-starting, proactive approach with the poise to prioritize multiple projects and recalibrate advice as priorities shift.
  • Communication: Excellent written and oral communication skills, with the ability to take complex legal and technical concepts and simplify the issues and desired outcomes.
  • Aptitude for Trade Compliance: A strong curiosity and willingness to learn trade compliance frameworks and analyze export law in relation to technical product details; prior trade compliance experience is not required.

Bonus Points

  • Process Perspective: A desire to build and strengthen workflows and "productization" processes that help a legal team scale.
  • Global Perspective: Comfortable working across time zones and cultures in a distributed culture with a flexible approach to problem-solving.

  • A bias towards execution, you fail fast, get things done, and thrive in ambiguity
  • Genuinely integrate AI in your day-to-day work, whether you've already built automated or AI-assisted workflows or are clearly heading in that direction and you view AI as a power multiplier
  • Highly responsive and collaborative, with the ability to communicate program status and performance clearly across teams

title: Emerging Enterprise Account Executive, West
description:
Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale — unleashing the potential of businesses and people. Elastic, the Search AI company, is looking for a high-energy Enterprise Account Executive to drive net-new revenue and expansion within strategic Enterprise accounts. You’ll be the owner of a defined territory where you’ll build your own pipeline, tell the Elastic Search AI story, and close complex, multi-stakeholder deals in a consumption-based model. This role sits at the intersection of sales execution, technical fluency, and cross-functional collaboration—and is critical to our growth in the Enterprise segment.

What You Will Be Doing

  • Own your territory & build pipeline: Develop and execute a proactive outbound cadence (email, call, social) that generates ≥50 % of your booked opportunities.

  • Deep discovery & qualification: Uncover pain, business impact, budget, and decision criteria using frameworks like MEDDPICC so you chase only the highest-confidence deals.

  • Value storytelling & demos: Craft and deliver tailored narratives and live demos that map Elastic’s Search, Observability, and Security capabilities to measurable business outcomes.

  • Mutual deal strategy & forecast accuracy: Collaborate with customers to build formal close plans and keep your CRM up-to-date, maintaining ≥90 % forecast accuracy within ±10 %.

  • Executive negotiation & closing: Lead high-stakes contract and pricing discussions—defend your value, structure give/get trades, and land multi-year consumption commitments.

  • Domain & cloud acumen: Position Elastic as the Search AI platform of choice by speaking fluently about cloud economics, usage-based pricing, and modern data architectures.

  • Cross-functional partnership: Work hand-in-glove with Solutions Architects, Customer Success, Marketing, and RevOps to accelerate deals and drive exceptional customer outcomes.

What You Bring

  • Proven SaaS quota‐carrying success: 5+ years closing complex Enterprise deals, consistently overachieving targets in a consumption-based or usage-model environment.

  • Expert discovery & qualification skills: Demonstrated ability to apply MEDDPICC or equivalent frameworks to drive disciplined pipeline and eliminate low-probability deals.

  • Compelling value storytellers: Track record of delivering executive-level presentations and demos that tie product capabilities to real dollars saved, revenue gained, or risk mitigated.

  • Strong negotiation chops: History of landing multi-year, high-ACV contracts while protecting margin and securing executive stakeholder buy-in.

  • Technical & cloud fluency: Comfortable discussing a broad range of technical topics including observability, security, vector/traditional search, and cloud cost optimization.

  • Collaborative mindset & coachability: A learner who partners effectively with internal teams, incorporates feedback, and embodies Elastic’s values of community and openness.

  • Open Source enthusiasm: Genuine appreciation for open-source communities and the Elastic model—bonus if you’ve sold or advocated in an OSS context.

Bonus Points

  • Prior experience at an open-source or developer‐centric infrastructure company.

  • Familiarity with observability (logs, metrics, traces) or security analytics (SIEM/XDR) use cases.

If you’re driven to build your own pipeline, master complex deal cycles, and help customers unlock the power of Search AI, we’d love to talk. Apply today!

This position allows you to engage in a variety of tasks, from maintaining systems to assisting colleagues with tech-related queries, all while working in a collaborative environment where your input is valued. If you enjoy problem-solving and have a keen interest in technology, this could be a great fit for you.

What You Will Be Doing

  • Respond to technical support requests from team members and diagnose hardware and software issues. Provide timely solutions and assist in training users on new technologies and tools. Document all support inquiries and resolutions, manage the office network and peripherals, and collaborate with vendors for hardware procurement.
  • Monitor system performance and address potential issues promptly. Analyze system logs to detect errors and irregularities. Document any configuration changes and maintain an inventory of hardware components and software licenses.
  • Identify and resolve network connectivity issues promptly. Configure and test network devices while performing regular assessments of network performance. Implement and manage security protocols to protect the network, and collaborate with external vendors to enhance network capabilities.
  • Assist users in troubleshooting software issues and provide guidance on best practices for effective software usage. Facilitate onboarding by educating new team members on IT tools and communicate important updates regarding technology systems. Gather user feedback to enhance IT services and support processes.

  • 2+ years in a technical support role within a corporate environment
  • 2+ years troubleshooting hardware and software, including repair
  • 1+ years in network configuration and administration
  • Experience with cloud-hosted solutions (Google Workspace, Okta, NetSuite, Salesforce)
  • Experience working with Cisco, Meraki, HP, and other network solutions
  • Hands-on experience with common office peripherals (printers, scanners, etc.)
  • Experience with hardware and software inventory management
  • Proficiency in Windows and macOS operating systems
  • Knowledge of network protocols (TCP/IP, DNS, IP addressing), routers, switches, firewalls, and wireless access points
  • Familiarity with device management systems (JAMF, Meraki, Intune)
  • Ability to analyse system logs to identify performance issues
  • Proficiency in ticketing systems for managing support requests.

title: Regional Vice President - Financial Services, Strategic Accounts
description:
Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale — unleashing the potential of businesses and people. What Is The Role:

Location: New York City
Elastic is looking for an exceptional Regional Vice President to lead our Financial Services Strategic Accounts business. This leader will be responsible for a team of experienced sales professionals serving some of the largest and most complex financial institutions in the world across banking, capital markets, payments, and insurance. This is a highly visible leadership role with significant responsibility for growth, customer relationships, talent, and execution. We are looking for a proven sales leader who knows how to build and run a high-performing business—not simply manage a territory.
 
You will set the strategy for the region, create and develop pipeline, coach and develop experienced sellers, build relationships with senior customer executives, and personally engage in our most important accounts and opportunities. You will establish a high standard for accountability, preparation, operational discipline, and customer engagement while creating an environment where talented people can do their best work.
 
The right leader understands how to build strategic, multi-year relationships with the world's largest financial institutions and can help customers solve critical business and technology challenges across Search, Security, Observability, data, and AI.
 
You will work closely with Elastic's executive leadership, product, engineering, customer success, partners, and broader field organization to bring the full strength of Elastic to our customers.
 

What You Will Be Doing:

  • Lead, develop, and inspire a team of experienced Strategic Account Executives responsible for some of Elastic's largest Financial Services customers.
  • Own the overall strategy, execution, and performance of the Financial Services region, including revenue attainment, pipeline creation, account growth, customer retention, and forecast accuracy.
  • Build a culture of high performance, accountability, collaboration, transparency, and continuous improvement.
  • Establish clear expectations and operating rhythms across account planning, pipeline generation, opportunity inspection, forecasting, executive engagement, and territory execution.
  • Lead from the front by actively engaging in our most strategic accounts, executive relationships, competitive situations, and complex opportunities.
  • Coach sellers beyond individual transactions to develop comprehensive, multi-year account strategies that expand Elastic's position across customers.
  • Build and maintain trusted relationships with senior executives, including CIOs, CTOs, CISOs, Chief Data Officers, infrastructure and engineering leaders, and business executives.
  • Create new pipeline by identifying customer priorities, whitespace, competitive displacement opportunities, and new workloads across Search, Security, Observability, data, and AI.
  • Drive disciplined execution of Elastic's sales methodology and maintain a high standard for opportunity qualification, deal strategy, pipeline coverage, and forecast accuracy.
  • Navigate complex enterprise buying environments involving technology, architecture, security, procurement, legal, risk, compliance, and regulatory stakeholders.
  • Identify risk early, develop clear action plans, and mobilize the right resources to improve customer and business outcomes.
  • Partner closely with Elastic executives and cross-functional leadership to align resources against our highest-value accounts and opportunities.
  • Develop strong relationships across the Financial Services ecosystem, including hyperscalers, global system integrators, technology partners, and other strategic partners.
  • Recruit, develop, retain, and raise the performance of exceptional sales talent.
  • Maintain a strong understanding of Elastic's platform, competitive landscape, customer use cases, and the evolving technology priorities of the Financial Services industry.
  • Travel regularly to engage customers, support the team, advance strategic opportunities, and build executive relationships.

What You Bring:

  • A demonstrated track record of building and leading high-performing enterprise or strategic sales organizations in complex technology markets.
  • Consistent success exceeding revenue targets and delivering predictable, sustainable growth.
  • Deep Financial Services experience, with meaningful exposure to major banking, capital markets, payments, and/or insurance organizations.
  • Established executive relationships within Tier-1 Financial Services institutions and demonstrated ability to build new C-level relationships.
  • Experience leading experienced enterprise sellers responsible for large, complex accounts and significant multi-million-dollar customer relationships.
  • Demonstrated ability to create pipeline and build new business—not simply manage an established book of business.
  • Strong executive presence and the ability to engage credibly with CIOs, CTOs, CISOs, data leaders, engineering executives, and senior business stakeholders.
  • Experience developing and executing strategic account plans that expand established relationships into new organizations, workloads, and buying centers.
  • Strong command of complex enterprise sales cycles involving multiple decision-makers, technical evaluations, competition, procurement, security, risk, and regulatory requirements.
  • Strong operating discipline across pipeline generation, qualification, forecasting, account planning, performance management, and inspection.
  • A history of recruiting, coaching, developing, and retaining exceptional sales talent.
  • The ability to coach experienced sellers while holding a high bar for preparation, accountability, and execution.
  • Sound business judgment and the ability to identify problems early, make decisions, and take ownership of outcomes.
  • The ability to translate complex technology capabilities into customer business outcomes and executive-level conversations.
  • The ability to operate with urgency and accountability while collaborating effectively across a highly matrixed organization.
  • A leadership style grounded in high standards, direct communication, teamwork, and a genuine commitment to developing people.

Bonus Points:

  • Experience with enterprise Search, Security, Observability, data platforms, cloud infrastructure, or AI technologies.
  • Experience working with open source or source-available technologies and communities.
  • Experience building and expanding strategic relationships across Global 2000 or similarly complex multinational customers.
  • Experience developing joint go-to-market strategies with hyperscalers, GSIs, and strategic technology partners.
  • Familiarity with Financial Services use cases including cybersecurity, fraud, real-time analytics, AI, application modernization, operational resilience, and regulatory compliance.
