Everpure (NYSE: P) has evolved from storage pioneer to data platform, closing fiscal 2026 with $3.7 billion in revenue, its first billion-dollar quarter, and accelerating growth into FY27. Our strategic agenda spans the companies defining the next era of technology - hyperscalers, AI labs, the AI hardware supply chain, data platform providers, and the broader AI ecosystem.

This type of work—work that changes the world—is what the tech industry was founded on. So, if you're ready to seize the endless opportunities and leave your mark, come join us.

THE ROLE...

The Inside Sales Organisation is where our company mission begins. The ISO serves two critical functions: 1) increasing Field Sales productivity by establishing qualified customer appointments, and 2) developing future sales leaders for field assignments.

Everpure’s Sales Development Program represents a guided path to developing sales expertise while offering career advancement through demonstrated achievement. This program includes new hire onboarding, mentor program, ongoing product and sales training, and daily opportunities to collaborate with peers and experts in the industry.  It emphasises a high-performance culture by establishing high activity habits, prospecting skills, writing skills, introductory call structures, sales and presentation skills. Inside Sales is a path to future opportunities for candidates eager to develop and invest their time, talents and energies in a hyper-growth, highly ambitious enterprise technology company firmly rooted in Silicon Valley and leading one of the most significant technology transitions occurring today: the transition from disk to flash storage.

Everpure and our Inside Sales Organisation thrive on a constructive, encouraging culture. We work hard and play hard! Successes are broadly shared and recognised while responsibility for individual performance remains a daily expectation. Individual accomplishments are rewarded but collaboration and teamwork is the lifeblood of ISO.

We have grown at record speeds and are looking to continue building our team of incredible talent with dynamic, ambitious energetic sales professionals looking to excel in their careers and help drive impact at Everpure.

We are seeking an accomplished Inside Sales professional for our growing market. This ideal candidate should have a proven ability to penetrate a targeted account base, create net-new opportunities, and exceed quota. The successful candidate will be bright, highly motivated, enthusiastic, professional, eager to learn and with a proven track record of succeeding. They are responsible for sales activities ranging from: prospecting targeted accounts, sourcing leads, qualifying opportunities, working with channel partners, and presenting initial virtual presentations to prospective clients and partners. You will be the first point of contact for prospects and will have a direct impact on the success of the company through your ability to effectively drive new business. This role is based out of Everpure’s EMEA headquarters’ in Staines, UK with remote support across the Nordics.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Prospect to identify net new opportunities
  • Identify, qualify and set appointments for field counterparts
  • Deep understanding and research on key target accounts
  • Work closely with Field Marketing to develop outbound call campaigns
  • Help progress opportunities as needed and directed with field AE.
  • Handle project upsells and renewals as needed.
  • Qualify and respond to daily marketing generated leads
  • Help drive attendance to scheduled partner events via email and/or calls
  • Work closely with Account Executive field sales to identify sales targets, initiatives and penetrate new accounts
  • Work with Channel on outbound prospecting campaigns with partners
  • Communicate early and often with Marketing on strategy, lead generation, lead programs
  • Continually keep up with current storage trends, companies, news releases, and competitor news
  • Daily use of sales enablement tools including but not limited to Salesforce.com, Discover.org Gmail, LinkedIn, Insidesales.com
  • Approximately 5-10% travel for trade show events, Enterprise Briefings and customer visits

WHAT YOU BRING

  • You MUST possess fluent, business level Swedish Language skills (Reading, writing, speaking)
  • Consistent track record of exceeding quota and penetrating net-new accounts 
  • Ability to effectively manage and prioritise various sales-related activities and fluently adapt to shifting priorities
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills
  • Ability to clearly communicate Everpure business value to varying roles in an IT organisation
  • Strong organisational skills and effective time management
  • Demonstrated ability to optimise performance and drive results in a fast-paced environment
  • Minimum 1-year experience in sales, preferably storage
  • Must be legally authorised to work in Germany without requiring visa sponsorship
  • You will be based in Munich. As this is an office-centric role, you are expected to be present in the office full time.

#LI-ONSITE

WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT FROM US:

  • Innovation: We celebrate those who think critically, like a challenge, and aspire to be trailblazers.
  • Growth: We give you the space and support to grow along with us and to contribute to something meaningful. We have been named Fortune's Best Workplaces in Technology™, Fortune's Best Workplaces in the Bay Area™, and certified as a Great Place to Work®!
  • Team: We build each other up and set aside ego for the greater good.

And because we understand the value of bringing your full and best self to work, we offer a variety of perks to manage a healthy balance, including flexible time off, wellness resources, and company-sponsored team events. Check out http://benefits.everpuredata.com/ for more information.

ACCOMMODATIONS AND ACCESSIBILITY:

Candidates with disabilities may request accommodations for all aspects of our hiring process. For more on this, contact us at TA-Ops@purestorage.com if you’re invited to an interview.

OUR COMMITMENT TO A STRONG AND INCLUSIVE TEAM:

We’re forging a future where everyone finds their rightful place and where every voice matters. Where uniqueness isn’t just accepted but embraced. That’s why we are committed to fostering the growth and development of every person, cultivating a sense of community through our Employee Resource Groups and advocating for inclusive leadership.

We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, transgender status, sexual stereotypes, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or any other characteristic legally protected by the laws of the jurisdiction in which you are being considered for hire.

THE ROLE

We are seeking an experienced Sales Operations Business Partner to partner closely with Country and District Managers across the METCA region. The role will provide dedicated operational support, business insight, and execution capacity to help sales leaders run their businesses effectively and improve seller productivity. Working as part of the EMEA Sales Operations organisation, the Ops partner will support forecasting, pipeline management, performance analysis, business reviews, planning, and operational execution. The role reports to the EMEA Sales Operations Director and will work closely with the METCA and EMEA leadership team and Regional Sales Operations Business Partner to translate regional priorities into consistent execution at country and district level.

The role will create operating leverage through:

  • District partnership: Providing Country and District Managers with the analysis, insight, and execution support required to improve sales performance.
  • Operating cadence: Supporting forecasting, pipeline reviews, business reviews, KPI reporting, and the follow-through needed to keep priorities on track.
  • Performance insight: Identifying trends, gaps, risks, and opportunities across pipeline, conversion, linearity, productivity, and territory performance.
  • Execution and follow-through: Operationalising agreed GTM priorities, coordinating actions, and helping remove recurring friction for sellers and managers.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Partner with sales leaders: Work closely with Country and District Managers to provide operational analysis, insight, and execution support across their businesses.
  • Support weekly forecasting: Prepare and inspect forecasts and pipeline, highlighting material movements, risks, opportunities, and areas requiring management attention.
  • Coordinate business reviews: Prepare district reviews, including KPI analysis, performance commentary, action capture, and follow-up.
  • Analyse performance: Assess pipeline coverage, conversion, linearity, seller productivity, territory, and account performance to identify gaps and opportunities.
  • Support planning: Contribute to annual and in-year GTM planning through territory, account, capacity, and quota analysis, working within agreed regional governance.
  • Operationalise decisions & Programmes: Coordinate the implementation and adoption of agreed GTM, organisational, and process changes with Regional Sales Operations and cross-functional teams.
  • Strengthen data discipline: Maintain high standards of CRM and forecasting hygiene, identify data-quality and process issues, and work with sales teams to resolve them.
  • Drive follow-through: Track actions, dependencies, and performance interventions arising from forecast calls, business reviews, and planning discussions.
  • Improve processes and alignment: Recommend practical improvements that reduce operational friction, and partner with Finance, HR, Deal Desk, Planning, and Corporate Operations to support execution.
  • Support account and deal execution: Coordinate account-planning, win/loss, and big-deal review cadences, providing analysis and tracking agreed actions through to completion.
  • Identify leading indicators: Monitor performance trends and leading indicators across pipeline, productivity, and execution, highlighting gaps and supporting agreed improvement initiatives.
  • Drive adoption and field feedback: Support adoption of new processes and tools, gather structured feedback from the field, and work with Regional Sales Operations to recommend practical improvements.
  • Coordinate cross-functional execution: Partner with Channel Operations, SE Operations, Renewals Operations, Finance, HR, Deal Desk, Planning, and other relevant teams to align priorities, coordinate dependencies, and ensure consistent execution across the district.



WHAT YOU'LL BRING

  • Experience: 5+ years of relevant experience in Sales Operations, Revenue Operations, Commercial Planning, business analytics, or a related role, ideally within a multinational technology company. 
  • Sales leadership partnership: Experience working with sales managers and senior commercial stakeholders in a fast-paced sales organisation. 
  • Sales operations knowledge: Strong understanding of forecasting, pipeline management, territory and quota processes, sales planning, and performance management. 
  • Analytical capability: Strong analytical and modelling skills, with the ability to interpret complex data, identify meaningful trends, and translate findings into clear recommendations. 
  • Tools and systems: Proficiency with CRM platforms such as Salesforce, forecasting tools such as Clari, and BI or visualization tools such as Tableau or Power BI.

THE ROLE

As our Security Operations Data Loss Prevention (DLP) Engineer, you will own and elevate Everpure’s enterprise data protection strategy across every digital and physical vector.

In this high-impact individual contributor role, you will establish data governance standards and architect practical controls that safeguard customer information, source code, intellectual property, and other sensitive assets without hindering business velocity. You will partner with Engineering, Legal, Privacy, DevSecOps, and GISO leadership to define how sensitive data is discovered, classified, monitored, and protected across the enterprise.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Architect Enterprise DLP Strategy: Own and mature the multi-channel DLP program end to end across endpoint, network, SaaS, application, cloud, and generative AI environments. Define program metrics, track outcomes, evaluate build-versus-buy decisions, and report data-protection posture to GISO leadership.
  • Establish Data Standards & Governance: Author data-classification frameworks, handling requirements, and exception processes. Maintain a sensitive-data map with data owners so the organization understands where regulated and proprietary data lives, how it is classified, and who is accountable for it.
  • Protect Endpoints & Physical Channels: Design and operate controls across macOS, Windows, and Linux, including removable media, printing, clipboard, screen capture, and local cloud-sync channels. Define requirements for hard-copy handling, device disposal, and media sanitization, including the specific needs of manufacturing and lab environments.
  • Protect Network, Application & Cloud Data: Define egress inspection strategies across email, web, and general network traffic, including practical SSL/TLS inspection boundaries and encrypted-flow visibility. Detect and prevent sensitive-data movement through applications, APIs, databases, file shares, CI/CD systems, and unstructured repositories while partnering with Cloud and DevSecOps teams across AWS, Azure, and GCP.
  • Protect AI Workflows & Sensitive Assets: Establish practical guardrails for sensitive data flowing into and out of public AI assistants, embedded copilots, internal models, and agentic tools. Address prompt content, file uploads, context windows, tool integrations, source code, and build-system secrets while enabling safe AI adoption.
  • Build Detections & Automate Response: Design, tune, and maintain high-fidelity DLP detections using regex, exact data match (EDM), indexed document matching (IDM), document fingerprinting, custom classifiers, and contextual conditions. Develop SIEM queries, correlate DLP events with identity, asset, vulnerability, and threat context, and integrate telemetry with SOAR platforms to reduce false positives and manual response effort.
  • Lead Investigations & Continuous Improvement: Direct investigations into significant data-loss events by reconstructing what left the enterprise, through which channel, and with what impact. Serve as the escalation point for complex findings, brief Legal, Privacy, HR, and leadership clearly, support audit and compliance engagements, and maintain runbooks, architectural diagrams, and program documentation.
  • Workplace Location: We are primarily an in-office environment and therefore, you will be expected to work from the Santa Clara or Lehi office in compliance with Everpure’s policies, unless you are on PTO, or work travel, or other approved leave.

WHAT YOU BRING

  • Enterprise DLP Ownership: Demonstrated experience owning or materially contributing to an enterprise DLP or data-protection program across architecture, deployment, policy design, tuning, operations, and continuous improvement.
  • Technical DLP Expertise: Hands-on experience with enterprise DLP technologies such as Microsoft Purview, Zscaler, Netskope, Forcepoint, Broadcom/Symantec, Trellix, CrowdStrike Data Protection, or equivalent platforms.
  • Detection Engineering: Strong experience with regex, EDM/IDM, document fingerprinting, data classification, custom classifiers, and detection tuning, including reducing false positives while maintaining effective coverage.
  • Data Discovery & Cloud Protection: Experience with data discovery, classification, CASB/SaaS security, cloud data protection, and controls for sensitive data across enterprise and cloud environments.
  • Automation & Investigation: Experience using Python, PowerShell, REST APIs, SIEM, and/or SOAR platforms to automate response, analyze telemetry, and improve operational outcomes.
  • Security & Privacy Frameworks: Working knowledge of data-protection and security frameworks such as NIST CSF, ISO 27001, SOC 2, GDPR, CCPA, PCI DSS, and HIPAA.
  • Communication & Judgment: Ability to translate complex data-protection risks into clear decisions and business outcomes for technical teams, cross-functional partners, executives, auditors, and other stakeholders. You know how to balance effective controls with user experience and business needs.

PREFERRED / PLUS SKILLS

  • Experience with AI/GenAI data protection, DSPM, insider risk, privacy engineering, or source-code and secrets protection.
  • Experience securing data in AWS, Azure, or GCP, or integrating data-protection controls into CI/CD, DevSecOps, containers, or Kubernetes.
  • Background in application security, cloud security, or privacy engineering.
  • Experience communicating data-protection strategy and posture to executives, auditors, regulators, or enterprise customers.

The centerpiece of the architecture is the policy engine - the declarative, intent-based component that holds the desired state of a customer's environment, evaluates live telemetry against it, and produces the violations that everything downstream acts on.

As a Senior Software Engineer, you will help define and build the core backend services behind this platform, including the declarative, intent-based policy engine at the center of the architecture. You will work closely with engineers in Prague and the US, product management, and architects to shape foundational capabilities and technical direction for a platform that will evolve over the next decade.

  • Build scalable and reliable processing for large volumes of fleet telemetry, enabling the platform to understand and respond to the state of customers’ environments.

THE ROLE

Everpure Cloud Dedicated (formerly Cloud Block Store) is Pure’s enterprise storage solution running in the public cloud. It brings the same features customers know from FlashArray - like data reduction (deduplication and compression), snapshots, encryption, and replication - directly into AWS and Azure. Because we reduce how much data actually needs to be stored and how many native cloud disks are required, customers can run their workloads in the cloud with lower storage cost and predictable performance instead of over‑provisioning native cloud volumes.

The service has been in production since 2019, serving enterprise, SaaS, and multicloud customers. It also acts as the storage engine for other Everpure Cloud offerings, such as Everpure Cloud Azure Native, where Azure users consume Pure storage as a native Azure service.

Our Prague‑based team owns the project on both AWS and Azure end‑to‑end. We design and build the core storage architecture, handle resiliency and performance work, and drive deployment and upgrade mechanisms. We also work closely with product managers, support, and field teams on customer issues and roadmap priorities. Because we run on top of AWS and Azure, we must deeply understand their building blocks (VMs, disks, networking, databases) and how Purity behaves on top of them.

For this role, we are looking for engineers who are curious about how things really work in the cloud, enjoy solving complex distributed‑systems problems, and are comfortable in a fast‑changing environment. Unlike traditional hardware projects, our work has to keep pace with new cloud services and features. You will help us evaluate new AWS and Azure capabilities and integrate them into our product to improve resiliency, performance, and cost efficiency for customers - while keeping the familiar, “FlashArray‑like” experience that Pure is known for.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Design, implement, and review new features in the Everpure Cloud Dedicated data path, primarily in C++ and/or Python, running on AWS and Azure.
  • Improve the resiliency, performance, and cost efficiency of our cloud storage stack (failover behavior, HA, capacity expansion, data reduction, cloud‑specific optimizations).
  • Participate in our triage rotation: analyze failures from CI pipelines and automated tests, debug issues on CBS testbeds, and drive fixes into the codebase.
  • Lead or co‑lead the investigation of product issues in customer environments, from initial escalation through root‑cause analysis and long‑term fixes.
  • Collaborate closely with Prague and US teams (data‑plane, control‑plane, QE, Support, Product Management, Solution Architects) to align on designs, rollouts, and operational best practices.
  • Contribute to and maintain technical documentation and runbooks so that other engineers, support, and field teams can operate the product with confidence. 
  • We are primarily an in-office environment and therefore, you will be expected to work from the Prague office in compliance with Everpure's policies, unless you are on PTO, or work travel, or other approved leave.

WHAT YOU BRING

  • Strong programming skills in C++ or Python and a willingness to pick up new languages, tools, and frameworks as needed.
  • End‑to‑end ownership mindset – from design and implementation through tests, CI pipelines, deployment, monitoring, and iterative hardening in production.
  • Strong debugging and problem‑solving skills, including working with complex logs, CI failures, and issues that cross service boundaries, APIs, and cloud components.

title: Account Executive, SaaS Product Line Specialist
description:
About the Team & Role

Rubrik's Product Line Sales organization drives focused growth across Rubrik's specialized workloads, including our SaaS data protection and security portfolio (Microsoft 365, Google Workspace, Salesforce, and other critical SaaS applications). This team partners closely with core Account Executives, Sales Engineers, and Customer Success to bring deep product and technical expertise into every SaaS opportunity — from first conversation through technical validation to close.

We're hiring a SaaS Product Line Sales Specialist to own and accelerate Rubrik's SaaS data protection business within a defined territory. This is a highly technical, quota-carrying overlay role: you'll be the subject-matter expert who can go deep on tenant architecture, identity and access models, backup and recovery mechanics, and the shared responsibility model — and use that fluency to win deals against SaaS-native point solutions. The ideal candidate has sold in this exact space before, at a company like AvePoint, CoreView, or Keepit, and understands both the buyer and the competitive landscape intimately.

What You’ll Do

  • Own the SaaS product line number: partner with core Account Executives to identify, qualify, and close SaaS data protection and security opportunities across net-new and existing accounts.
  • Lead with technical credibility: articulate Rubrik’s SaaS architecture, security posture, and the gaps in Microsoft’s and Google’s native shared responsibility model in a way that resonates with both technical and business buyers.
  • Drive technical discovery and validation: run or co-lead discovery calls, demos, and proof-of-concept engagements for M365, Google Workspace, and Salesforce workloads alongside Sales Engineers.
  • Win competitive deals: build and defend positioning against SaaS-native vendors (AvePoint, CoreView, Keepit, Veeam, Druva, and similar), translating technical differentiation into business value.
  • Build territory and account plans: develop a coverage strategy in partnership with core sales, SE, and channel teams to maximize SaaS attach and expansion within the install base.
  • Engage multiple stakeholders: present to IT administrators, security and compliance teams, and executive economic buyers, tailoring the message to each audience.
  • Forecast with discipline: maintain accurate pipeline and forecast data in Salesforce and participate in regular business reviews.
  • Stay current: maintain deep knowledge of Rubrik’s SaaS roadmap, the M365/Google Workspace/Salesforce ecosystems, and the competitive landscape.

Experience You’ll Need

  • SaaS sales experience: 3+ years of quota-carrying sales experience selling SaaS data protection, security, or governance solutions for Microsoft 365, Google Workspace, or Salesforce environments.
  • Directly relevant background: experience at a SaaS data protection or management vendor such as AvePoint, CoreView, or Keepit (or a comparable company like Druva, Veeam, or Spanning) is strongly preferred.
  • Genuine technical depth: comfortable discussing tenant architecture, APIs, identity and access management (Entra ID/Azure AD), backup and recovery mechanics, and security and compliance frameworks without relying solely on a Sales Engineer.
  • Proven technical selling motion: a track record of running or co-leading technical discovery and proof-of-concept engagements, not just handing off to a technical resource.
  • Consultative approach: comfortable navigating complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles across IT, security, and executive buyers in mid-market and enterprise accounts.
  • Overlay/specialist experience: prior success working in a platform-selling model alongside core Account Executives, Sales Engineers, and Customer Success.
  • Track record: consistent history of quota attainment and strong pipeline generation.
  • Education: bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Hands-on familiarity with Microsoft 365 administration, Entra ID/Azure AD, or Salesforce administration.
  • Experience selling a data security or resiliency platform that spans SaaS, cloud, and on-premises workloads.
  • Existing relationships with IT, security, or compliance buyers in target accounts.

description:

We are looking for a highly organised and motivated Project/ Program Manager Intern to join our dynamic team. As an intern, you'll assist in managing our On Prem/Saas  product delivery. You will assist in the planning, managing, and execution of several technical programs and initiatives each year for our Engineering Organisation across our Product portfolio.   • Exposure to Cloud Platforms - AWS/Azure/GCP

  • Exposure to Enterprise product development

- CGPA 8 and above

title: HR Business Partner, Corporate Functions
description:
HR Business Partner, Corporate Functions 

About the Role

We're looking for a new member of our People team who loves all things People! This HRBP role sits within the HR Business Partner team, supporting the Corporate Functions (Finance, Accounting, IT, Infosec and Legal) and Marketing client groups. You'll partner closely with Senior HR Business Partners to deliver a world class day-to-day experience for employees and managers, with a strong focus on employee relations and building the coaching capability of our first-line and mid-level managers. This role will be based in Palo Alto, CA. Onsite 3 days per week. 

What You'll Do

  • Be an AI-native HRBP, not just an AI user. Question how People work gets done today (manager coaching prep, ER documentation, program rollouts) and bring ideas to redesign the workflow around AI rather than just speeding up the old one. Know where human judgment stays non-negotiable; ER, coaching, and sensitive conversations are never handed off
  • Let data not just anecdotes guide how you coach managers and flag emerging people trends and issues
  • Serve as a trusted, go-to partner for employee relations, helping managers and employees work through workplace concerns, guiding them to the right resolution, and escalating complex or sensitive cases to the Senior HRBP as needed
  • Build the coaching capability of first-line and mid-level managers, helping them grow their own people leadership skills rather than just solving issues for them. Covering organizational health, employee engagement, development, and policy interpretation
  • Partner with and support the Senior HR Business Partner(s) on business-specific people initiatives and roadmap execution
  • Support execution of annual people programs (year-end and mid-year performance reviews, talent reviews, compensation planning, engagement initiatives, succession planning) in partnership with the Senior HRBP
  • Partner with Centers of Excellence (Compensation, Talent Acquisition, Talent & Development, DEI, People Operations) to help identify and support process improvements
  • Translate ambiguous people/policy questions into clear guidance and next steps, communicating HR concepts simply and effectively to managers at all levels
  • Support change management efforts at the team level, helping first-line and mid-level managers navigate organizational or process changes with their teams
  • Use AI tools (e.g., Copilot, ChatGPT, or similar) to help draft manager communications, summarize employee relations notes, prep for coaching conversations, and speed up policy research and first-pass answers, always with a human review before anything goes to an employee or manager

Experience You'll Need

  • 5+ years of progressive HR experience, ideally with some generalist or HRBP exposure
  • Experience handling employee relations matters and coaching first-line and mid-level managers through people challenges
  • Foundational experience supporting performance and compensation cycles, manager coaching, or learning & development programs
  • Working knowledge of basic labor law concepts 
  • Strong relationship-building skills, comfortable partnering with managers at multiple levels, peers, and cross-functional HR teams
  • Experience working in or with a global/distributed team environment
  • Comfort using AI tools in daily work to boost productivity, paired with sharp judgment about when human review and empathy matter most
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills

title: HR Business Partner R&D
description:
HR Business Partner, R&D

Location: Palo Alto, CA (3 days in office)

 

We are seeking an experienced HR Business Partner, R&D to partner with managers across Engineering, Product, Design, and Customer Support to strengthen manager capability, build high-performing teams, and drive business and talent outcomes.

This hands-on role focuses on manager coaching, performance management, compensation planning, organizational health, and people program execution. As a trusted advisor, you will help managers navigate complex people decisions, improve team performance, and build the capabilities required to achieve business objectives.  You will diagnose organizational challenges, identify opportunities and translate them into practical, high-impact people solutions. You will also help shape the future of HR business partnering by leveraging AI and agentic workflows to improve decision quality, expand HRBP leverage, enhance manager support, and deliver scalable people solutions.

This role is designed for a highly accountable HRBP who thrives in a high-velocity environment, takes ownership of outcomes, has strong bias for action, proactively solves problems, and continuously improves how work gets done.  The ideal candidate combines the judgment of a trusted advisor, the execution rigor of an operator, and the mindset of a builder.

 

Scope of Impact

 

Business Partnership

  • Build trusted partnerships with managers and leaders across supported R&D organizations, serving as a credible advisor on talent, organization, and people-related decisions.
  • Translate business objectives into practical solutions that enable organizational effectiveness.
  • Balance business priorities, employee experience, and long-term organizational implications when advising managers
  • Proactively identify organizational risks, capability gaps, talent concerns, and workforce trends, and drive recommendations that improve business outcomes.

Manager & Leadership Capability

  • Advise first-line and mid-level managers on people leadership, performance management, employee development, engagement, organizational health, and team effectiveness.
  • Identify capability gaps and implement targeted interventions that strengthen manager effectiveness and team performance.
  • Coach managers through challenging employee situations, difficult conversations, performance concerns, organizational change, and development planning.
  • Provide guidance on HR policies, processes, and people practices while reinforcing broader organizational considerations.
  • Deliver manager enablement and leadership development initiatives that improve effectiveness and consistency at scale.

Performance, Talent Management and Compensation 

  • Own execution of annual people programs, including performance reviews, calibration discussions, talent reviews, and compensation planning, ensuring high-quality outcomes and strong manager engagement
  • Coach managers through complex performance management decisions and strengthen performance expectations, accountability, and employee development practices.
  • Identify talent, retention, succession, and capability risks and develop mitigation plans with managers 
  • Partner on compensation decisions aligned with company philosophy and leverage workforce insights to improve decision quality.

HR Program Design, Execution & AI-Enabled Transformation

  • Design, implement, scale, and improve people programs that enhance manager effectiveness and organizational outcomes.
  • Simplify, automate, and redesign people processes with a focus on outcomes rather than digitizing legacy workflows.
  • Champion AI, automation, and agentic workflows across HRBP work to improve decision quality, increase capacity, and deliver scalable people solutions and  impact beyond traditional human capacity.
  • Deliver integrated HR solutions in partnership with the broader People team and identify innovative approaches that improve productivity, adoption, and effectiveness.

Organizational Health, Engagement & Development

  • Advise leaders on organizational health, culture, and team effectiveness while strengthening the development, retention, and engagement of key talent.
  • Use workforce sentiment, organizational insights, and people analytics to identify risks, diagnose challenges, and implement sustainable solutions.

Employee Relations

  • Provide guidance and independently manage moderate to complex employee relations matters using sound judgment and risk assessment.
  • Resolve employee concerns in partnership with managers and collaborate with Legal on sensitive, high-risk, or specialized matters.

How You Create Impact

  • Translate complex business priorities into focused, executable people solutions.
  • Influence decisions through expertise, credibility, and practical problem-solving.
  • Demonstrate urgency, ownership, and follow-through while balancing strategic thinking with hands-on execution.
  • Leverage data, organizational insight, and systems thinking to diagnose challenges and develop scalable solutions.
  • Strengthen manager effectiveness through coaching, development, and enablement.
  • Drive execution of talent, performance, compensation, and people programs that improve organizational outcomes.
  • Navigate employee relations and performance matters with sound judgment and appropriate risk assessment.
  • Leverage AI, automation, and agentic workflows to increase impact, productivity, and scale while maintaining an enterprise mindset.

What Success Looks Like

  • Be known for speed, ownership, sound judgment, and turning ambiguous people challenges into actionable solutions.
  • Build trusted advisor relationships with managers who proactively seek your guidance on critical talent and organizational decisions.
  • Elevate manager capability, accountability, and team effectiveness across supported organizations.
  • Deliver strong execution of performance, talent, compensation, and people programs that improve business outcomes.
  • Anticipate organizational risks and continuously improve how people work is delivered through AI, automation, and scalable solutions.

Qualifications & Experience

  • Required Qualifications: Minimum 8 years of progressive HR experience, including at least 3+ years as a People Partner or HR Business Partner, with a Bachelor's degree in Business, Human Resources, or a related field; or 6+ years of experience with a Master's degree.
  • Preferred Qualifications: Experience supporting R&D client group

title: Inside Sales Engineer (Remote)
description:
Job Description

Rubrik is looking for Inside Sales Engineers. As an Inside Sales Engineer, you will receive on the job training with our Field and Sales Engineering teammates . We are expanding our team and investing in individuals who have a technical foundation and an interest to become our next Sales Engineer accountable for regional revenue goals by driving innovative technical programs and overseeing day-to-day account-level activities. You will be responsible for evangelizing, positioning, and architecting the industry's first hyper-converged hybrid cloud data management platform for a mix of mid-market and small business customers throughout your region.

 

About the position:

  • Provides technical leadership and direction to customers and internal staff in the development of fully integrated technology solutions in support of pre-sales activities, directly supporting 2-3 Account Executives across assigned North East territories.

  • Assists in the analysis, design and development of fully integrated technology solutions.

  • Demonstrates technical leadership and subject matter expertise on Rubrik’s products, distributed architectures, file systems, and competitive storage offerings in the SAN product space.

  • Acts as technical expert and consultant to develop and propose solutions that meet the technology and business requirements of assigned customers.

  • Makes technical and sales presentations and demonstrations to our channel partners’ and customers’ technical staff and senior management.

  • Serves as a trusted technology advisor to customers and serves as an internal resource on technical issues or specific business applications within an assigned market segment.

  • Successfully builds relationships with the account team, partners and customers in support of sales team objectives and engages and leverages corporate resources, abilities, budgets and personnel as appropriate.

  • Leads technical sales calls.

  • Qualifies sales opportunities in the terms of customer technical requirements, competition, decision making process and funding.

 

About you:

 

  • Must be located in the North East.

  • 1-5 years of sales engineering experience preferably in a software or data center environment.

  • Driven – need for success, highly energetic with a strong hands-on, “can do” approach.

  • The successful candidate must have a fundamental breadth of technical knowledge in cloud data management, backup and disaster recovery and data analytics.

  • Entrepreneurial - willing to go the extra mile, strong work ethic, resourceful, “get it done” attitude.

  • Strives in moving in a fast-paced environment; including handling multiple calls/demos per day with immediate follow up.

  • A high level of business acumen and experience working with Cx0 level personnel, bringing technology solutions to solve business challenges.

  • Smart, adaptable and open-minded.

  • Bachelor’s degree required or equivalent experience.

description:
Your Career at Rubrik

For more information, please visit www.rubrik.com and follow @rubrikInc on X (formerly Twitter) and Rubrik on LinkedIn.

About the Product Team 

The Product Team at Rubrik is responsible for driving Rubrik’s mission of securing the world’s data by creating products that simplify the complexity of managing cyber resilience across all applications and types of data. We seek to build consumer-grade experiences to solve the hardest and most complex enterprise challenges.

What Product Growth, Specifically, Does at Rubrik

Rubrik’s Product Growth team sits within product management and reports into Anneka Gupta, Chief Product Officer of Rubrik. Our team bridges Product Management, Analytics, and GTM Strategy to shape Rubrik’s monetization and business model vision. We are responsible for accelerating Rubrik’s business growth by identifying and unlocking levers across the customer lifecycle. Specifically, our team focuses on:

  • Monetization & Packaging Strategy: Designing pricing models, tiering structures, and add-on packaging for core SaaS and AI products.
  • Product-Led Growth & Adoption: Analyzing product telemetry and usage patterns to reduce friction, drive feature adoption, and accelerate time-to-value for customers.
  • Expansion & GTM Alignment: Identifying cross-sell and upsell opportunities, optimizing packaging for new market segments, and aligning product capabilities with sales motions.
  • Business Operations & Margin Optimization: Evaluating product economics, cost structures, and gross margin trade-offs to support sustainable, profitable growth.

About the Role

Reporting to a manager on our Product Growth team, you will help design and execute high-impact business models aligned with customer value.

In this role, you will address top-of-mind strategic questions for executive leadership while having direct input into shaping your summer projects based on your interests and business needs. Past intern and team projects have included a combination of designing new product monetization strategies, mapping margin recovery paths, and developing internal AI tools to improve Rubrik’s GTM motions.

Responsibilities include: 

  • Lead the execution and implementation of pricing, packaging, and overall monetization decisions across core platform products and new product initiatives.
  • Partner cross-functionally across Product, Marketing, Finance, and Engineering to execute and operationalize new business strategies.
  • Synthesize complex data and market insights into actionable business recommendations.
  • Be a "player-coach," guiding team members to improve capabilities and ensuring a collaborative and high-performing team environment.

About You (Your Impact)

You possess a strong blend of strategic thinking, technical curiosity, and financial acumen. You approach challenges with an analytical mindset, using data to bring clarity to ambiguous business problems. You are results-driven, ready to take full ownership of initiatives, and excel at both independent problem solving and cross-functional collaboration.

You bring a high sense of ownership and a true bias for action. Equally important, you operate with humility. You know when to dive deep on your own, when to raise your hand for help, and how to leverage team expertise to deliver the best solution.

Qualifications:

  • Education: MBA from a top program strongly preferred.
  • Graduation: Spring 2027 - 2028
  • Experience: Minimum of 3 years of experience in pricing, product management, management consulting, investment banking, or business operations. 
  • Domain Expertise: Ideally you have demonstrated experience in B2B SaaS. Bonus points for familiarity with AI or cybersecurity products.
  • Analytical Skills: Advanced financial modeling, market analysis, and problem-solving capabilities; ability to translate data into actionable insights and clear recommendations.
  • Communication Excellence: Strong verbal and written communication skills, including executive-ready presentation capabilities, with meticulous attention to detail.
  • Technical Curiosity: Passion for technology and willingness to delve deeply into technical product landscapes.
  • Collaborative Leadership: Demonstrated ability to work cross-functionally and influence stakeholders across functions and levels of seniority.
  • Execution-Oriented: Proven track record of delivering results in fast-paced, dynamic environments.

title: Sales Development Representative
description:
About Rubrik's Sales Organization

Rubrik's sales team helps enterprises and government entities achieve cyber resilience — protection against cyberattacks, malicious insiders, and operational disruptions. Our One Rubrik selling approach means you'll have cross-functional support, dedicated enablement resources, and a clear path to exceed your goals and grow your career. All while doing something that matters: protecting the world's data.

About This Role

Sales Development Representatives are the engine of Rubrik's go-to-market strategy. Through targeted outbound prospecting and inbound lead qualification, you'll generate a high-quality pipeline for our field sales teams. This means researching accounts, crafting personalized outreach, and earning meetings with decision-makers at organizations that need what Rubrik offers.

This is a launchpad role — built to develop you into a full-cycle sales professional. Our SDRs receive structured coaching, ongoing training, and a defined career path into closing roles.

What You'll Do

Prospecting & Pipeline Generation

  • Research target accounts, identify high-potential contacts, and craft personalized outreach across email, phone, and social channels to generate qualified meetings for field sales teams
  • Leverage customer success stories, case studies, and proof points in your outreach to demonstrate real-world impact — connecting a prospect's pain to how Rubrik has already solved it for organizations like theirs
  • Follow up on marketing-generated inbound leads within established SLA and compliance metrics
  • Manage your pipeline, leads, and activity data in Salesforce with discipline and accuracy
  • Track and report on your performance against defined activity and outcome targets

Collaboration & Strategy

  • Partner with your aligned field sales team to develop account strategies and break into priority accounts
  • Stay current on cybersecurity trends, the competitive landscape, and industry developments to sharpen your messaging and relevance
  • Develop deep fluency in Rubrik's products and the business problems we solve for customers
  • Participate in ongoing coaching sessions, call reviews, pitch competitions, and bootcamps designed to accelerate your sales skills.

What You'll Bring

Required:

  • 0–2 years of experience in B2B sales, lead generation, or a customer-facing role (internships and non-traditional backgrounds welcome)
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills
  • Interest and aptitude for learning technical concepts quickly
  • Comfort working in a metrics-driven environment with clear daily and weekly targets
  • A genuine desire to build a career in sales and business development
  • Ability to work out of Rubrik's Austin office a minimum of 4 days a week
  • Work-authorization: U.S. citizenship and residency on U.S. soil required

Preferred:

  • Familiarity with Salesforce, Outreach, Orum, or similar sales engagement tools
  • Exposure to cybersecurity or data management technology
  • Experience using AI-powered sales tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Gong, Clari, 6sense) to improve prospecting efficiency

What Makes Someone Successful Here

  • Intellectually Hungry — You ask questions, seek feedback, and treat every conversation as a chance to learn something new
  • Integrity — You're honest with prospects, teammates, and yourself. You do the right thing even when no one is watching
  • Execution-Focused — You prioritize ruthlessly, manage your time well, and consistently deliver against your activity and outcome targets
  • Collaborative — You celebrate team wins, share what's working, and actively contribute to a culture that makes everyone better
  • Driven — You hold yourself to a higher standard than anyone else would set for you
  • AI-Tool Fluent — You actively integrate AI and automation into your daily workflow — whether that's using AI-assisted research to build smarter account plans, leveraging tools like conversational intelligence platforms to sharpen call performance, or using generative AI to draft and iterate on personalized outreach at speed. You see AI as a force multiplier, not a shortcut

title: Security Engineer - Identity and Access
description:
About the team 

The Information Security organization advances the overall state of security at Rubrik through purposeful initiatives and coordination of large security projects. Information Security builds technologies, tools, and processes to better enable teams at Rubrik to develop secure software and protect data and systems with appropriate security controls. Information Security also develops systems to monitor and respond to attacks against our systems, provides awareness education to teams on security best practices for data protection, and ensures data sharing relationships with third parties in order to securely protect Rubrik information.3

About the role

We are looking for an experienced and technically deep Identity and Access Management (IAM) Engineer to execute technical strategy across our entire Identity and Access Security management program. This domain spans a broad and increasingly complex set of disciplines, including Identity Governance & Administration (IGA), Access Management, Privileged Access Management (PAM), Non-Human Identity (NHI) security, and the emerging space of Agentic Identity security. 

This is fundamentally a hands-on role. You will be expected to personally design systems from the ground up and build automation that scales across a large and diverse application portfolio. At the same time, this role carries significant cross-functional weight: you will be partnering closely and continuously with Information Security, IT, Engineering and the many application-owning teams distributed across the company, driving the identity security initiatives in alignment with the overall business objectives.

What you'll do

  • Solution Design
    Design and build IAM solutions — including configurations, integrations, and workflows — that align with evolving business requirements, security policies and regulatory requirements (eg., SOX, GDPR).
  • Application Onboarding & Integration
    Lead the onboarding of applications into IAM platforms, integrating across diverse systems including major cloud platforms, SaaS applications, and in-house systems.
  • Build automation and policy-as-code frameworks
    Manage identity access policies as versioned, auditable code — using source control, CI/CD, and infrastructure-as-code to automate identity and access management changes instead of manual, ticket-driven processes.
  • Deepen identity governance platform integrations
    Build and extend automated provisioning/deprovisioning, entitlement aggregation, and access certification workflows across the application portfolio.
  • Privileged Access Management
    Design privileged access models across applications and endpoints — including session management and just-in-time elevation — to minimize standing access without slowing teams down.
  • Non-human/Agentic identity governance
    Build inventory, risk-scoring, runtime policy enforcement and remediation tooling for service accounts, API keys, workload identities, AI agents etc 
  • IAM Platform Auditing & Posture Management
    Review and audit identity and access management platforms to identify security misconfigurations, strengthen security policies, and enforce industry best practices.
  • Incident Response & Forensics Support
    Provide subject matter expertise during security incidents to support investigations into identity and access related events.
  • On-Call Coverage & Escalations
    Engage in on-call rotations and provide technical escalation support outside standard business hours. 
  • Technical governance and design reviews
    Enforce technical standards across the team, evaluate identity related design proposals, and serve as the main escalation point for complex identity security decisions and integration challenges

Experience you'll need

  • Minimum of 6 years of experience in Identity and Access Management (IAM), with deep hands-on experience implementing and managing IAM solutions within leading cloud environments such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud Platform.
  • Proficiency with modern identity platforms (e.g., SailPoint, Okta, CyberArk, or equivalents) and identity protocols such as SAML, OpenID Connect, and OAuth.
  • Strong understanding of Identity Governance, Privileged Access Management (PAM) principles, Non-Human Identities/AI Identities and Access Certification processes.
  • Proficiency in a general-purpose programming language (e.g., Python, Go), with experience in infrastructure-as-code (IaC) and CI/CD tooling (e.g., Terraform, GitHub Actions) preferred.
  • Demonstrated experience designing least-privilege / RBAC or ABAC models at scale, and reasoning about tradeoffs between security posture and developer/user friction.
  • Experience operating in a regulated environment (e.g., SOX) and translating control requirements into engineering work.
  • Track record of technical leadership: driving cross-team design decisions, writing technical documentation.

Additional skills

  • Effective communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to convey complex information clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to lead cross-functional collaborations and drive technical security initiatives.
  • Ability to quickly learn, adapt, and lead in fast-paced and dynamic technical environments.

title: Software Engineer, Atlas Distributed Systems
description:
About Team

Rubrik Atlas is the core data path for all Rubrik products, whether in the data center, at the edge, or in the cloud. It is a distributed, scale-out, fault tolerant, performant, deduplicated user-space filesystem that uniquely combines block device (ext4/NFS/SMB) and S3 backend storage interfaces. It has been the cornerstone of Rubrik’s innovative tech stack since Day 1.

Since inception this team has attracted some of our strongest technical talent with a very high bar for quality and velocity. We are looking for motivated engineers, who can complement this rockstar team!

 

About Role

Rubrik is expanding at a rapid pace in all directions, from supporting various applications (like Kubernetes, Oracle, EC2, and RDS protection) to hardware storage platforms (like SSD, HDD, S3, Azure Blob, and EBS), to revolutionizing cloud protection (such as SaaS protection, data security, and immutability). At the heart of this transformation is our Atlas platform. We are looking for an experienced distributed systems engineer to guide us through the next stage of the evolution of our data platform.

As an engineer in the team, you’ll design, develop and deliver cutting-edge solutions for the tectonic shifts mentioned above. You will be responsible for outlining the architectural principles we should build towards, prototyping changes, and working with the team to realize the vision in a production-quality system. Your technical direction will also impact multiple teams across Rubrik, as we will need to guide them on how to best build on top of Atlas.

There will be a wide range of features to work on, including cloud storage-backed file systems with effective cost analysis, building data formats optimized for read and write performance for all workloads, deduplication and compression, reliability, resiliency, infinite scalability, performance tooling using eBPF, asynchronous programming, various read-ahead techniques, snapshotting, data integrity, data security, data immutability in the cloud, and many more.

This opportunity provides a potent mix of dynamism, fast startup-like culture, serious technical challenges, and influence across many teams and leaders. If all this sounds interesting, or if you want to know more, please reach out.

 

What are we looking for? 

  • Bachelor’s and/or Master’s degree in Computer Science or equivalent
  • 3+ years of experience in Distributed File System
  • Strong fundamentals in distributed systems design and development
  • Experience in building systems at scale and backend development
  • Hands on with the code and have hands-on coding skills in C++

 

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with storage solutions or data protection is a huge plus
  • Experience with nuances public cloud features and costs (like compute, storage, networking, data services) on public clouds (AWS, Azure, GCP)

title: Software Engineer - IAM
description:
Location : Pune
About Team & About Role:

 

As a Software Engineer (SE) in the Continuous Product Delivery (CPD) team, you will play a key role in providing long term stability and last mile delight to our customers. You will work closely with the core engineering team, product, and support org.

You will be working across Rubrik releases on our on-premise data backup & management offering, with a focus on the identity and access layer that secures it. You are expected to develop a strong understanding of our product and engineering architecture — particularly how authentication and authorization flow through the system, including our integrations with enterprise identity providers, directory services, and certificate-based trust chains.

We are seeking a highly skilled Golang developer with deep, practical experience in identity protocols (OIDC/OAuth 2.0, SAML 2.0) and applied cryptography/PKI. As a Software Engineer on this team, you will be responsible for designing, building, and hardening the systems that authenticate users, machines, and services across our platform — reasoning carefully about threat models, not just shipping features. You should have strong programming and troubleshooting skills, excellent design skills, and a solid understanding of distributed systems, OS fundamentals, and networking. The successful candidate will preferably have working knowledge of Active Directory and be able to work independently and as part of a team.

 

 
Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and harden identity and access flows — OIDC/OAuth 2.0, SAML 2.0, Active Directory integrations — that sit in front of mission-critical systems.
  • Own token and assertion lifecycle correctness: issuance, validation, expiry, rotation, and failure-mode handling for JWT/JWKS and SAML assertions.
  • Apply strong applied-cryptography and PKI practices (X.509 certs, key rotation, TLS) to keep the auth path secure by default, not as an afterthought.
  • Build and maintain reverse-proxy/HTTP-layer components (TLS termination, header handling) that front customer authentication traffic.
  • Debug and resolve customer-facing identity/access issues, working with support to triage escalations quickly.
  • Contribute to build/release and cross-platform packaging (Linux deb/rpm, Windows MSI) as needed.
  • Maintain a small Windows companion application written in C#/.NET.
  • Write and enhance end-to-end tests covering auth flows, failure modes, and edge cases (clock skew, revoked tokens, malformed assertions, etc.).
  • Document known issues, workarounds, and design decisions in the team knowledge base as the team and product mature.
  • Communicate clearly with product and engineering stakeholders on design tradeoffs, security posture, and escalation status.

Requirements

Must-have
  • Strong hands-on programming skills in Golang.
  • Deep, practical knowledge of identity protocols: OIDC/OAuth 2.0 and SAML 2.0 — including token/assertion internals, standard flows, and failure modes.
  • Working knowledge of Active Directory.
  • Applied cryptography/PKI experience: X.509, JWT/JWKS, key rotation, TLS.
  • Strong security engineering discipline — comfortable reasoning about threat models and building software to protect mission-critical systems, not just make features work.
  • Solid understanding of OS fundamentals, networking, and concurrency.
  • Working knowledge of Linux; comfortable writing shell/bash scripts.
  • Simple, effective written and verbal communication.
Nice-to-have
  • Directory internals (schema, bind operations).
  • HTTP internals and reverse proxying (TLS, header injection).
  • Build/release and cross-platform packaging (Linux deb/rpm, Windows MSI).
  • Secret-manager internals, Redis, Win32, policy engines.
  • Basic C#/.NET (to maintain the companion app).

title: Talent Partner
description:
Talent Partner, G&A

Location: Bengaluru, India — Hybrid Department: People — Talent Acquisition

 

About the Role

You'll lead hiring for Rubrik's G&A organization in India, and be the talent voice in the room when leaders decide how those teams get built. This is a senior individual-contributor seat: you'll run the hardest G&A searches yourself — Finance, Legal, People, IT, Business Operations — while advising VPs on leveling, location, and org shape, and setting the standard the wider Talent Partner team follows.

About the Team

Rubrik's India Talent Acquisition team hires across Engineering, Go-to-Market, and G&A from our Bengaluru site, one of the company's fastest-growing locations. You'll be among the most senior recruiters here, partnering with functional leaders and their global counterparts, and looked to by peers on how full life-cycle recruiting should be done.

What You'll Do

  • Lead full life-cycle recruitment for Rubrik's most complex and senior G&A searches in India — leadership hires and scarce specialist roles alike.
  • Advise Senior Manager and above stakeholders on hiring strategy, driving leveling decisions, team composition, and location choices rather than reacting to them.
  • Design and run sourcing strategies across channels and modalities without direction, using competitive intelligence to move passive talent who weren't looking.
  • Make diverse pipelines structural to every search: build them into intake, involve interview panels in sourcing, and evidence the outcome req by req.
  • Bring internal talent and mobility into the conversation with your business partners, treating early-career and internal-promotion paths as real options.
  • Lead a Talent Acquisition initiative that outlasts a single req — candidate experience, interviewer calibration, reporting, or process improvement — and pull the team into it.
  • Set the bar on tools and process: model best practice in the ATS, teach peers, and challenge how we work when there's a better way.

What You'll Bring

  • 6+ years of full life-cycle recruiting, with several years owning senior and leadership hiring for G&A or corporate functions.
  • A record of independently running complex searches to close across more than one function or business unit.
  • Credibility with Senior stakeholders — evidence that your talent recommendations changed a hiring decision, a level, or an org design.
  • Fluency with market and competitive intelligence data, and the judgment to forecast a search with reliable accuracy.
  • Advanced command of an ATS and sourcing stack, at the level where peers come to you for guidance.
  • Persuasive communication under pressure: you can close a senior candidate and reframe a panel's view of a profile in the same week.
  • Deep knowledge of the Indian talent market across cities and functions.

Bonus Points

  • Building or scaling G&A hiring at a public or recently public technology company.
  • Leading a cross-functional TA initiative with measurable results.
  • Partnering with HR and Finance on headcount and location planning.

 

You'll embody Rubrik's RIVET values — Relentlessness, Integrity, Velocity, Excellence, and Transparency — in how you collaborate, make decisions, and show up for Stakeholders and teammates.

The DLP Engineer is responsible for the design, implementation, and continuous improvement of technical controls that protect organizational data across endpoint, email, network, cloud, collaboration, and emerging AI platforms. This role serves as a key member of the Security Engineering team and acts as a bridge between business policy requirements and technical security implementations.

The ideal candidate possesses a strong understanding of data protection principles along with the technical expertise required to translate governance, compliance, privacy, and security policies into effective technical controls. This position focuses on the engineering, configuration, optimization, and maintenance of data protection technologies rather than day-to-day alert monitoring or incident response activities.

The DLP Engineer partners closely with Compliance, Legal, Privacy, Information Governance, Security Architecture, Identity and Access Management, Security Operations, and Information Technology teams to ensure data protection requirements are effectively implemented and enforced across the enterprise.

This role combines project-based work, including deployment of new data protection capabilities and enhancements, with operational responsibilities involving support, maintenance, tuning, and continuous improvement of existing security technologies.

 

Position Responsibilities:

Data Security Engineering

  • Design, implement, configure, and maintain enterprise data protection technologies and controls.
  • Develop and maintain technical solutions that protect sensitive information across endpoints, email systems, cloud environments, collaboration platforms, networks, and AI-enabled technologies.
  • Implement controls that reduce the risk of unauthorized disclosure, misuse, exfiltration, or exposure of sensitive organizational data.
  • Evaluate emerging data security technologies and recommend solutions that improve organizational security posture.
  • Participate in security architecture reviews and provide engineering expertise related to data protection capabilities.

Policy Translation and Technical Implementation

  • Partner with Compliance, Privacy, Legal, Information Governance, and Security Policy teams to understand regulatory, contractual, and business requirements.
  • Translate policy requirements into technical controls, detection logic, classifications, and enforcement mechanisms.
  • Design and implement DLP and information protection policies that align with approved governance requirements.
  • Ensure technical implementations accurately reflect business and compliance objectives.
  • Provide technical input during policy development and review activities.

Security Platform Administration

  • Administer and support enterprise data protection and information security platforms.
  • Develop and maintain operational procedures, technical documentation, standards, and implementation guides.
  • Perform testing, validation, troubleshooting, and tuning of data protection controls to improve effectiveness and reduce false positives.
  • Coordinate upgrades, integrations, maintenance activities, and platform lifecycle management.
  • Support implementation of new security capabilities and enhancements across the organization.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Work closely with Security Architecture teams to align technical controls with enterprise security strategy.
  • Partner with Identity and Access Management teams on data-centric access control initiatives.
  • Collaborate with Security Operations teams to improve data visibility and detection capabilities.
  • Support technology teams and business stakeholders during implementation of data protection requirements.
  • Participate in assessments of new applications, cloud services, and AI-enabled platforms to ensure data protection requirements are addressed.

Continuous Improvement

  • Analyze effectiveness of existing data protection controls and recommend improvements.
  • Identify opportunities for automation and operational efficiencies.
  • Assist with development of metrics, reporting, and measurement related to data security capabilities.
  • Stay current on emerging threats, technologies, regulatory developments, and industry best practices.
  • Contribute to the ongoing maturity of the organization's data protection program.

 

Position Requirements:

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Information Security, Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 3-5 years of experience in Data Security Engineering, Information Protection, DLP Engineering, Data Protection, or a related security discipline.
  • Experience implementing and administering enterprise data protection technologies.
  • Experience designing and maintaining security controls across endpoint, email, cloud, network, and collaboration environments.
  • Understanding of data classification, information governance, privacy, and data protection principles.
  • Experience translating business, compliance, privacy, or regulatory requirements into technical security controls.
  • Strong troubleshooting and analytical problem-solving skills.
  • Experience working with cross-functional teams and multiple stakeholder groups.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and projects simultaneously.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience with Microsoft Purview Information Protection and Data Loss Prevention.
  • Experience implementing DLP capabilities across endpoint, email, cloud, network, and SaaS environments.
  • Experience with AI governance, AI security controls, or AI-related data protection technologies.
  • Knowledge of Microsoft 365 security and compliance capabilities.
  • Experience with data classification, sensitivity labeling, and information protection technologies.
  • Familiarity with regulatory frameworks such as GDPR, CCPA, HIPAA, PCI-DSS, SOX, or similar standards.
  • Experience with Insider Risk Management programs and technologies.
  • Familiarity with automation and scripting technologies such as PowerShell or Python.
  • Security certifications such as SC-400, CISSP, Security+, SC-300, AZ-500, or equivalent.

Commvault (NASDAQ: CVLT) is the gold standard in cyber resilience. For over 25 years, more than 100,000 organizations and a vast partner ecosystem have relied on Commvault to reduce risks, improve governance, and do more with data. 

Clumio is bought by builders. The people who evaluate us are Staff engineers, SREs, platform leads, and directors of engineering—people who will decide whether to trust us with 50 petabytes of S3 before they ever talk to a salesperson. They arrive from a search result, an AI assistant, or a colleague’s recommendation. They open the docs. They start a trial. And within about twenty minutes, they either get their first backup running or they close the tab. 

This role owns that twenty minutes—and everything that leads up to it. 

You are not a documentation writer who sits downstream of engineering and turns release notes into paragraphs. You are a content engineer: you run the code, you build the example, you break the workflow, and then you write the thing that makes it obvious. Every guide you publish ships with something that actually works—a Terraform module, a CloudFormation template, a CLI walkthrough, a tested API call. If a builder can’t copy it, paste it, and have it succeed on the first try, it isn’t finished. 

You will sit with the Cloud Native product organization and work shoulder-to-shoulder with engineering, product, and growth. Your work is the top of the funnel, the onboarding path, and the reason a trial converts. 

Why This Role Matters 

Clumio is one of the top products in AWS Marketplace and carries an NPS of 88, and we got there because builders tried it and it worked. But the ceiling on a product-led motion is set by how many people can succeed without us in the room—and right now, that ceiling is our content. 

If you are the engineer who kept ending up writing the guide everyone linked to, or the writer who got tired of describing software you were never allowed to run—this is the seat where those are the same job. 

 

What You’ll Do:

Own the Content That Sells the Product 

  • Write and maintain the Clumio docs—getting-started paths, service-by-service protection guides, API and SDK references, restore and recovery runbooks—treating them as a product surface, not an archive 
  • Build the fastest possible path to first value: a builder should get their first S3 bucket, DynamoDB table, or RDS instance protected without opening a support ticket or booking a call 
  • Author deep technical guides on the workloads that define us—S3 at scale, Apache Iceberg and S3 Tables, DynamoDB, EC2/EBS, RDS/Aurora—including the hard parts: cost, scale, recovery time, and what happens when something goes wrong 
  • Own the technical narrative in AWS Marketplace listings, trial flows, and in-product onboarding copy 

Build It Before You Write About It 

  • Ship and maintain working example repositories: Terraform modules, CloudFormation and CDK templates, scripts, and sample integrations that builders can fork 
  • Test every workflow you document in a real AWS environment—validate the code, validate the permissions, validate the failure modes 
  • Build the hands-on lab and GameDay content used at AWS events, where builders break something and recover it themselves 
  • Produce short technical demos and walkthroughs—written, visual, or recorded—that show the product doing the thing rather than describing it 

Write for How Builders Actually Find Things 

  • Create content that ranks in search and—increasingly—gets retrieved and cited by AI assistants: specific mechanisms, worked examples, real numbers, and concrete scenarios rather than hedged feature claims 
  • Identify the questions builders are already asking about cloud data protection and answer them better than anyone else has 
  • Turn customer-scale reality into public proof: petabytes, object counts, recovery times, cost deltas 

Close the Loop with Product and Growth

  • Bring friction back to engineering and product—when the docs have to apologize for the product, the product is the bug

What Success Looks Like 

  • Builders reach first value in a trial without human help, and the activation curve shows it 
  • Docs and guides are a measurable source of qualified signups, not a cost center

  • When an engineer asks an AI assistant how to protect S3 at scale, our content is what it draws from 
  • Support tickets that used to be “how do I…” questions stop arriving, because the answer is already published 

Your First 90 Days 

  • Week 1: You run the trial yourself as a new user would, and write down every place you got stuck

What You Bring

  • The instinct of a teacher—you know where a reader will get confused before they do, and you write to that

Nice to Have

  • AWS certification, or a personal AWS account with a billing history that tells a story

description:
